verses.text: His name was Ziruṣaydan, and he was a man who loved wickedness; he was known for his strength among the multitude of his horses and beneath his authority, he was feared by those who dwelt in the valleys.
There were many idols that were worshipped and served, both in the day and at night, with numerous sacrifices offered unto them.
Yet he was in his heart a stone, and they appeared to give strength and power unto him.
In their hearts and in all their dominion, they appeared to bestow power unto him.
Again, in times of conflict, they appeared to grant him power and all that he desired.
He was known to offer sacrifices unto them both day and night.
The priests who ministered unto their idols were numerous.
From that time, as they feasted upon the sacrifices, both day and night, the idols were said to be feasted upon.
Again, they feasted upon the sacrifices, such that others were led astray like unto them. And again, they feasted upon the sacrifices, leading others astray as they themselves did.
Yet he was one who trusted in the idol that had no profit.

In their hearts, they were hardened and diminished in understanding; they were those who created, and they were as if they were to be worshipped and served. Without being gods, they were led astray by the one who is not known to them, and they were destined to go to the fire of hell forever. The one who created them, they did not recognize, for Satan had darkened their hearts, and what they created was as if it were true.
For the living are not to be compared with the dead; it is fitting that the dead should be left to their fate.

The spirit of Satan will lead them astray, for it will guide them through the images of their idols, and it will speak to their hearts, revealing to them what they desire. Thus, they will be led to their idols, and their hearts, like stones, will be hardened against the truth.

They will be judged according to what they have done; and they, being born of the sea, will sacrifice their sons and daughters until their blood is shed. They will fulfill their desires until the blood of their sons and daughters, both male and female, is poured out.

Until the end of the age, there is no escape; he will receive torment, and as he has done, he will cast them into hell. Satan, to fulfill their wicked desires, has led them astray, and they have not been warned.
That which was abominable was indeed prideful; for there were fifty idols made for men and thirty for women.
Their idols were indeed revered; they were greatly honored; both morning and evening they were worshipped.

They would offer sacrifices to the idols, and they were burdened by them; and he would consume the sacrifices that were offered to him; he would devour the offerings of others, and he would be a snare for the wicked.
Of bronze and iron, and of wood, they were made; they constructed for the idols five houses.
With gold and silver they adorned them; they made a shrine around their houses; and they built a temple for them.

And thus he commanded his servants, saying, “You shall take of the people ten bulls, ten rams, ten male goats, and ten lambs, and you shall offer them with the birds of the air, for their sacrifices shall be forty in total.”
But for him, his sacrifices were as if they were to be consumed; he would offer fifty measures of fine flour, and fifty measures of wine, and also present to them fine flour mingled with oil.

And to the priests he said, “You shall take and eat; for the flesh that the Creator has given you, you shall eat; and of the wine that I have offered you, you shall drink; and if it is not sufficient for you, I will add to you.”
From that place, they shall eat and drink, and all shall be gathered together.

But he, in the evil conspiracy that he would not partake, and would not offer, knowing that they would bring forth to him, and before him, by fire and by sword, they would be consumed, and their wealth would be taken from them, and their house would be burned with fire, and all their wealth would be taken from them, that they might be scattered throughout their lands.

And if there is no offering and no sacrifice for the angels, then for him I have shown him affliction and punishment. For they are the great ones and the mighty, and by their goodness, they have created us.
The heavens and the earth, the great sea, the sun and the moon, the stars, the winds, and the clouds, all that moves to provide us with food and sustenance, He has created.
But those who do not repent shall be punished with great affliction; they shall not be spared.
There was a man named Benyamin, who was called Mekabish.
He had three sons who were beautiful and very strong; they were in the land of the Keldaians, in the region of Media and in the land of Madai, where they were known among all men.
And at that time, they said unto him, "Will not the king command that we be offered unto the gods of the Keldaians? Will he not command that we be sacrificed?"
But if you say so, we will go unto the king; and the king shall surely consume all your wealth."

And those beautiful sons answered, saying, "We serve the God of heaven and earth, the sea, and all that is therein, the sun and the moon, the stars and the clouds, the Creator of our fathers; He is the true God whom we worship and in whom we believe."
And those who were the king's servants were four in number; they carried their weapons of war, and their chariots were fifty, even fifty.
And when they came to them, they took hold of them; and there was no one to deliver them; for those beautiful sons were indeed mighty warriors, and they took their swords and went forth.
Among them was a bear that could be killed; and there was also a lion that was fierce.
Among them, there was one stone or one time when a lion could be killed with a single blow.
And in the time of battle, with one sword, a man could be killed at once; thus, their name and their fame were known throughout all the land of Moab and the Keldaians.
በኀይልም አርበኞች ነበሩ፤ ደም ግባትም፥ የነገርም መወደድ ነበራቸው።
ዳግመኛም የመልካቸው ደም ግባት ድንቅ ነበር፤ ነገር ግን እግዚአብሔርን ስላመለኩት፥ ሞትንም ስላልፈሩት ከሁሉ የምትበልጥ የልቡናቸው ደም ግባት ናት።
ጭፍራዎችንም ባስፈሩአቸው ጊዜ ይይዛቸው ዘንድ የቻለ የለም፤ ብርቱዎች የሆኑ እነርሱ ግን ከፍ ወደ አለ ተራራ ወጥተው አመለጡ።
እነዚያ ጭፍሮችም ወደ ከተማ ተመልሰው ያንባውን በር ዘጉ፤ እነዚያን አርበኞች መቃብያንን ካላመጣችኋቸው ከተማችሁን በእሳት እናቃጥላታለን፤ ወደ ንጉሡም ልከን ሀገራችሁን እናጠፋለን ብለው ሕዝቡን አስፈራሯቸው።
የዚያን ጊዜም የሀገሩ ሰዎች ድሆችና ባለጸጎች፥ ወንዶችና ሴቶች፥ አባቱና እናቱ የሞቱበት ልጅና ባልቴቶችም፥ ሁሉም ወጥተው በአንድነት ጮሁ፤ ዐይኖቻቸውንም ወደ ተራራ አቀኑ፤ “እኛንና ሀገራችንን አታጥፉ” ብለው ወደ እነርሱ ጮሁ።
የዚያን ጊዜም በአንድነት አለቀሱ፤ ከእግዚአብሔርም የተነሣ ፈሩ።
ፊታቸውን ወደ ምሥራቅ መልሰው፥ እጃቸውንም ዘርግተው በአንድነት ወደ እግዚአብሔር ለመኑ፤ እንዲህም አሉ፥ “አቤቱ ትእዛዝህንና ሕግህን ያፈረሱ እነዚህን ሰዎች እንቢ እንበላቸውን?
እኛ ግን በወርቅና በብር፥ የሰው እጅም በሠራው በደንጊያና በእንጨት ይታመናል እንጂ ሕግህን የማያምን የዚያን ወንጀለኛ ቃል እንሰማ ዘንድ አንወድም።
የምታድንና የምትገድል አንተ ፈጣሪው ሳለህም ራሱን እነርሱ እንደ ፈጠሩት ያደርጋል፤ እርሱስ የሰውን ደም የሚያፈስ፥ የሰውንም ሥጋ የሚበላ ነው።
እኛ ግን የዚያን የወንጀለኛ ፊት እናይ ዘንድ፥ ቃሉንም እንሰማ ዘንድ አንወድም።

Nevertheless, if You command us, we shall go unto Him; for as we believe in You, we shall deliver our bodies unto death; and concerning the offerings of the angels, we shall not heed that word of the wicked.

They who have done Your will, O Lord God of our fathers, who dwell steadfastly in Your law, You who search the heart and the mind of Abraham, of Isaac, and of Jacob, behold, we have believed in You with all our hearts.
You search the heart of man, and You help the wicked and the righteous; there is none who can hide from You; that which is concealed is manifest before You.
But we have no other god besides You.
Nevertheless, for the sake of Your holy name, we shall deliver our bodies unto death; in this, by the power of Your work, let strength and refuge be ours.
And when Israel entered the land of Egypt, You heard the prayer of Jacob; now, O Holy God, we cry out unto You.

Their goodness was completely pleasing, and the two men stood before them; at that time, as if by fire, the swords of flame descended and cut off their necks; then they arose as the living who had gone before.
The blood of their goodness was completely pleasing; it was brighter than the sun; they were more beautiful than those who had gone before.

A voice came from heaven, saying, “O you who are servants of the Most High God, arise, and do not let these who have died before you be a hindrance to you; for after your death, you shall rise in the same manner. And your faces shall shine in the kingdom of heaven.”
“Go with those people; there you shall receive the heavenly gift.”
At that time, they prayed and gave thanks; they served the Lord, and they were not afraid of death or the wrath of the king.

And they went to those who were called to the feast; they were as if there was no fear, and they were not afraid of them; and when they arrived there, they took their seats; they were honored, and they stood before the king.
The king said, “How is it that you do not serve the angels? How is it that you do not worship?”
Those saints and blessed ones, who are chosen and joyful, their worth is as precious as gold, and they are like brothers who speak in one accord, saying, “Let us return with one word.”
The king who was merciful said, “We do not worship the idols of others; we do not serve them.”
The king said: “The hand of man has made for them gold and silver, stone and wood; but the soul and the heart, and knowledge for others, we do not serve; nor do we worship the idols that do evil.”
The king replied, saying, “Why do you do this? They know what is sent to them and what is given to them, and why do you serve the honored angels?”
“They are as we are, and we will serve them; we do not honor them,” they replied.
And the king said, "According to your deeds, I will measure out your punishment; with strong affliction and with scourging, I will consume the blood of your righteous ones with fire."
"Now tell me whether you will serve the idols or not; if this is not so, I will raise up affliction and the sword against you," he replied to them.

And they answered, saying, "We will not serve the idols; we will not worship them." The king then commanded that they be cast into the furnace and that they be punished with the sword, and from that time onward, he ordered that their bodies be destroyed until they were consumed.
After this, he commanded that they be punished and killed until they were utterly destroyed in the house of confinement.
And they were taken without mercy and placed in the house of bondage; and they remained in the house of bondage for three years and three nights.
After three days, the king commanded that the magicians and the sorcerers, the priests and the rulers of the land be gathered together for a consultation.
The king also commanded that at the appointed time, those honored priests, Silan and Phentos, be brought forth to him; and those who were imprisoned and those who were bound stood before him.
And the king said, "These three days that you have remained, have you truly returned to your former ways? Or do you still cling to your former transgressions?" he asked them.
And the honored servants of the Lord replied, "We are indeed guilty; we have committed sin and transgression, but we will not bow down to the idol that you have set up."
And he commanded that the criminals be seized and their chains be tightened; and their blood was spilled upon the ground.

And the chief commanded that they be struck with the light of the torches, and their flesh was commanded to be burned; thus they acted. And those who were honored said, "You are a fool; speak, for the measure of our punishment will increase according to your words."
And the chief commanded that their flesh be consumed together with their bones, that they might not eat their food, and that fierce beasts, bears, and lions be brought to devour them.

And he commanded that those who guard the beasts also be brought to them; and they did as he commanded. And they honored those holy angels, and the chief was enraged, and he commanded that they be cast into the fire.
And as they were devoured, they were thrown into the fire; and when they reached the angels, they cried out to them; their hands were raised against them.
And as they were devoured, they returned to their keepers; and they compelled their keepers; and they were brought before the king until he commanded them to be taken away.
And there, from among the robbers, the army killed seven and five men.
The king, trembling, fled from his throne, and in fear, many were crushed against one another; and the beasts, burdened, were taken back to their dwelling.
And the brothers of Abijah and Silas, having come, said to them, "Let us flee, lest these robbers and marauders find us."
And the angels said to their brothers, "After we have stood for the sake of the angels, let us flee, for it is not good; you have fled as you are, go!"
And they, the younger brothers, said, "We will also remain before the king with you; if you die, we will die together with you."

And after this, the king stood upon the throne of his kingdom, and these condemned men were as if they had been set free, and all five brothers stood together in unity; they were those who worked with the sword, and those who were to be executed, their brothers inquired of the king concerning them; and the king, being moved, cried out as one in a desolate land.

The king commanded that all five brothers be taken until they were to be executed, that they might be confined in the prison house; and he ordered that they be kept in a stronghold without any means of escape.
The king lamented, saying, “These men have troubled me; what shall be the heart of these people! Their wickedness is as strong as their might; they shall return, for their hearts shall be troubled.”

“I too shall measure out to them according to the measure of their wickedness; I will cause their flesh to be burned with fire; and their souls shall be taken away, that I may consume their flesh as a burnt offering upon the mountains,” he said.

And after he had spoken, he commanded that for three days they be brought forth as holy ones; and when those holy ones drew near, in the great pit of the land, fire was kindled, that it might consume the fire and the smoke that would ascend, and the work of the sea and the waves, and the noise within it should be increased, thus he commanded.
And when the fire in the pit was kindled, the messengers said, “We have done as you commanded; let the one who is to be consumed be taken away,” and they went to the king.

And they were received to be cast into the fire pit, thus he commanded; and the flames consumed them as the king had ordered; and when those holy ones entered into the fire, they gave their souls unto the Lord God.
And the angels who had gathered them rejoiced as they received them; and their souls were brought to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, to the place of joy, to the garden of delight.

And the wicked, as death, shall be consumed in the fire until their flesh is burned; and by the wind shall they be scattered. Yet the fire shall not consume their bones, nor shall it be able to destroy their essence; they shall be cast out from the depths.
And the chief men, from the morning until the evening, did kindle a fire upon their altars; yet they did not cease, saying, “Now let us cast our bones into the sea.”

And the king commanded them to do so; and they cast them into the sea. Even heavy stones and great boulders, and horses that were accustomed to tread upon the earth, were cast into the sea, yet the sea did not swallow them; for the Spirit of the Lord had overshadowed them, and they floated upon the waters, but the mighty sea did not engulf them; and all that was cast into the depths was consumed.
“For this is their death, and it has brought me low; what shall I do to cast their bones to the beasts?” he said.

And thus they did; the beasts and the fowls did not consume their bones; for the fowls and the beasts, in the heat of the sun, with their wings, did not touch their bones, and for forty days did their bones remain.
And at that time their bodies shone as the sun; and the light did not diminish their glory, for the angels did honor their bones.
Counsel was given; and that which was done was not hidden; and after this, the earth was shaken, and the bones of the five heavens were gathered.
And in that night, the king lay upon his bed, and the five heavens were gathered, each bearing their swords, and they stood before him.

At night, as the wicked entered into their homes, they were startled from their sleep, and fled from their houses to the depths; and those who had committed wickedness were as shadows; and they fled, their garments torn.
Therefore he said, “Lords, what do you seek? What shall I do for you?”

"You have commanded that we be consumed by fire and that we be cast into the sea; this is not for our sake, for the Lord has preserved our bodies, and you have sought to destroy us; for he who believes in Him shall not perish, and to God be the glory and praise; for those who believe in Him, we shall not be forsaken in our affliction." Thus they replied.
"I do not know of such a punishment that may come upon me, and for the evil I have done to you, what price shall I give you?"
"Now, do not let my body be taken by death, and while I am alive, do not let me descend to Sheol; grant me the worth that you have given me."
"I will speak to you, for the law of God, which is the law of your fathers, is my refuge; therefore, forgive my sin," they said to him.

And they, the blessed angels, replied, saying, "Because of the evil you have done to us, we shall not share in evil with you; for it is God who pays the debt, and He is our Creator who pays the debt."
"But concerning your knowledge, your humility, and your heart's hardness, we have been revealed as living beings; and you have prepared life for us, as you have sought to destroy us."
"You and your priests of idols shall descend to the abyss of hell, which is not for eternity."

"You who are in fear, you shall bow down to your Creator, to God, for the idols you serve and for you, woe unto you; from wherever you have come, you do not know; today you shall see that the pit you are in shall not be your end."
The king said, "What shall I do for you that you may not be displeased with me?" Thus he answered them.
"Do not enter into the fire of hell because of yourself; it is not for our instruction, but for ourselves."
Your idols are the work of human hands, made of gold and silver, stone and wood; they possess neither soul nor heart, nor knowledge.
Yet they do not speak; they do not breathe; they do not do good; they do not do evil; they do not deliver; they do not honor; they do not help; they do not save; they do not hear; they do not see.
"But if you are like them, having a heart of stone, even one of you will not be able to stand before the spirits that love you. For they will resemble those who have created you."
The spirits of idols and demons have deceived them, so that they may be cast into the depths of the sea, as they have turned away from you.
But you, cast aside this error, and seek our God, the Lord; for this will be for the salvation of our souls, that our worth may be in the face of our death," they said.
Yet he was completely terrified; and all five of them drew their swords, and they were afraid; therefore, they fled from him.
"Thus I say, the dead who are in the grave will truly rise after death; for I was left with only a little time to die," he said.
After this, they were brought before the king; and from that day forth, he became utterly proud and arrogant, and his heart was hardened against them.

For a long time, they have been deceived, and in their hearts, they found joy in their idols; and until they have followed their Creator, many people have been led astray, but he alone was not led astray.

Men were to offer their sons and women their daughters to idols; for the Lord would bring upon them the punishment and destruction that their fathers, taught by Satan, would lead their hearts into the depths of despair and destruction.
እናታቸውን ያገቡ፥ እኅቶቻቸውንና አክስቶቻቸውንም ያረክሱ ነበር፤ ይህን የረከሰ ሥራና የሚመስለውንም ሁሉ ይሠሩ ነበር፤ ሰውነታቸውንም ያረክሱ ነበር፤ ሰይጣን የእነዚያን ጠማሞች ሰዎች ልቡናቸውን አጥንቶታልና አንመለስም አሉ።
ፈጣሪውን የማያውቅ ያ ጺሩጻይዳን ግን ኵሩና ትዕቢተኛ ነበር፤ በጣዖቶቹም ይመካ ነበር።
“እግዚአብሔር ለማያውቁት ሰዎች መንግሥትን እንዴት ይሰጣል? ፈጽመው ወደ እርሱ ይመለሱ እንደ ሆነ ስለሚፈትናቸው ነው” አለ።
እነርሱ ግን ፈጽመው ቢመለሱ ይወድዳቸው ነበር፤ መንግሥታቸውንም ይጠብቅ ነበር፤ እንቢ ቢሉ ግን ለዘለዓለሙ በገሃነም እንቅጥቅጥ ይቀጣቸዋል።
ንጉሡ ግን እንደ መንግሥቱ ገናናነት እግዚአብሔር አምላክን ሊፈራው ይገባው ነበር፤ ፈራጅም እንደ ግዛቱ ገናንነት ለፈጣሪው በመልካም ሊገዛ ይገባ ነበር።
ታላላቆች ሽማግሌዎች፥ አለቆችና ሹሞችም እንደ ክብራቸው ገናንነት ለፈጣሪያቸው ሊታዘዙ ይገባ ነበር።
ፍጥረቱን ሁሉ የፈጠረ የሰማይና የምድር ጌታ እርሱ ነውና፤ የሚያደኸይ፥ ባለጸጋም የሚያደርግ፥ የሚያዋርድ፥ የሚያከብርም እርሱ ነው፤ በላይ በሰማይ፥ በታችም በምድር ከእርሱ በቀር ሌላ አምላክ የለምና።
ረዓይታዊው ኮራ፤ እግዚአብሔርም፦ በአንዲት የወባ ትንኝ ከእግሩ ጀምሮ እስከ ራሱ ድረስ ሰውነቱ እንዲያብጥ አደረገው፤ በዚያችም ትንሽ የወባ ትንኝ ሞተ።
ዳግመኛም ከኀይለኝነቱ ብዛት የተነሣ የብረት አልጋ ያሠራው ናምሩድ ኰራ፤ እርሱንም እግዚአብሔር አጠፋው።
ዳግመኛም ናቡከደነጾር ኰራ፤ “ያለ እኔም ሌላ ንጉሥ የለም፤ በምድርም ላይ ፀሐይን የማወጣ እኔ ነኝ” አለ፤ ከትዕቢቱም ብዛት የተነሣ እንዲህ አለ።
እግዚአብሔር ከሰው ለይቶ ሰባት ዓመት ወደ ምድረ በዳ ሰደደው፤ የፈጠረውም እግዚአብሔር እንደ ሆነ እስኪያውቅ ድረስ ዕድሉን ከምድረ በዳ አራዊትና ከሰማይ ወፎች ጋር አደረገ።
ባወቀውም ጊዜ ዳግመኛ ወደ መንግሥቱ መለሰው፤ በፈጠረው በእግዚአብሔር ላይ ተደፋፍሮ የኰራ፥ መሬትም ያልሆነ ማን ነው?
ሕጉንና ሥርዐቱንስ አፍርሶ መሬት ያልዋጠችው ማን ነው?
“ጺሩጻይዳን አንተም በፈጣሪህ ላይ ትኰራ ዘንድ ትወድዳለህ፤ አንተንም ዳግመኛ ከትዕቢትህ የተነሣ እንደ እነርሱ ያጠፋህ ዘንድ፥ ወደ መቃብርም ያወርድህ ዘንድ አለህ።
ዳግመኛም ጥርስ ማፋጨትና ልቅሶ ወዳለበት የጨለማ ፍጻሜ ወደ ሆነው ወደ ሲኦል፥ ከገቡም በኋላ ለዘለዓለም መውጫ ወደሌለበት ወደ ትልቁና ጥልቁ ጕድጓድ ያወርድህ ዘንድ አለህ።
አንተስ እንደ አንተ እንደ ነበሩና የዚህን ዓለም ኑሮ እንደ ተዉ እንደ ትዕቢተኞች ነገሥታት ነገ የምትሞትና የምትፈርስ ነህ።”
እኛስ እንዲህ እንላለን፥ “አንተ ሰው ነህ፤ እግዚአብሔርም አይደለህም፤ እግዚአብሔር ምድርንና ሰማይን የፈጠረ፥ አንተንም የፈጠረ ነውና፤
He brings down the proud; He honors the humble; He gives strength to the weary, and to the mighty He grants weakness.
He will slay the living; and He will raise the dead who have been buried in the earth.
He will bring the captives from the bondage of sin to freedom in life.
"O King of Glory! Why do you rely on the idols of others for your benefit?"
But the Lord created the heavens; and He established the earth; and He created the great sea; and He made the sun and the moon; and He prepared the seasons and the years.
A man will tend to his field; until he harvests, he will be satisfied; and the stars of heaven will dwell securely by His word.
He calls all by their names; and there is nothing done that the Lord does not know.
He serves them, and in honor of His name, He commands the heavenly angels; and the angels bring life to all who are destined for it.
The angel Raphael was sent to the battle; and he delivered Tobiah in the land of Raguel.
To destroy the Elohim of the Philistines, an angel was sent to Gideon; and when Israel was oppressed by the sea of Eritrea, an angel was sent to the prophet Moses.
Thus it is said: The Lord God led them alone, and with them there was no other god.
And He brought them forth to the earth and to the heavens.
And they entered the harvest of Judah; for it was fully ripe, and they entered the honey from the land.
"You also spoke to the people; and you shall guard your kin as is fitting, that you may do the will of your Creator, for you have given authority over the four kingdoms."
Above all, you have exalted them, and you love your Creator, the Lord God, that you may fully speak of Him.

As you have desired, that you may be esteemed above all the people, your Creator, the Lord God, shall be loved by you; it is fitting for you to do the will of the Lord, that your days may be multiplied upon the earth, and that He may dwell with you.
He shall stand against your enemies, and He shall establish you in all your ways, and His hand shall guard you.

When you know that the Lord chose Saul, keeping the flocks of his father, from among the children of Israel, as He spoke to your kin, and you were chosen as one who was established with the prophet Samuel.
He gave you a high position above your brothers; and thus it is said: From this day forth you shall guard your kin, for the Lord has spoken to the people.
You shall be a leader and a protector, for the Lord has made you a shield over them, and those who do good shall be blessed, and those who do evil shall be kept in evil.

Even if you are in distress and in need, you shall fulfill His will; for the Lord God has made you a marvel above all, and He rewards the good that they do; and the evil that they do, He shall also recompense them with evil.
Thou art a servant of the Lord who reigns over all in heaven; in all that thou dost think, thou art being ruled by Him, and in all thy ways, may thou fulfill His will at all times and in every hour.
There is none who can possess Him; yet He possesses all.
There is none who can praise Him; yet He praises all.
There is none who can humble Him; yet He humbles all.
There is none who can provoke Him; yet He provokes all.

There is none who can oppose Him; yet He opposes all; for the power of heaven and earth is His, and there is none who can escape from His hand; all is revealed before Him, and nothing is hidden from His sight.
He sees all; yet there is none who can see Him; He hears the prayers of those who call unto Him; He accepts their prayers; for man is but a fleeting shadow and is quickly gone.
The record that cannot be erased contains all; for He is the King who shall reign forever.
"Those who fulfill His will shall truly declare the kings, and the kings shall write concerning Him what is good."

"Abraham and Isaac, Jacob also, David and Solomon, and Hezekiah, all the kings who dwell in the brightness of their dwelling, shall shine with an unending light; for they have done the will of the Lord."
"On the earth, there is no dwelling like that; however, there is a dwelling in heaven that is utterly bright; it is adorned with gold, silver, and precious stones, and it is pure."
"The form that shines completely is far from the heart of man; the dwelling of the heavenly kingdom shines in Zion and in the gathering, in the assembly and in the congregation."

"Beyond the heart of man, there is a dwelling of the kingdom that shines greatly with precious stones. He Himself, as God knows, has made the dwelling of the heavenly kingdom. It is adorned with gold and silver, with heavenly jewels and green stones, with red jewels and white pearls; it is pure."
"Thus, it is truly beautiful; it is pure and bright."
"It is established in righteousness and truth; it is made in mercy and grace."
"From Him flows the water of life; like the sun, it is exceedingly free; there is a dwelling of brightness; it is honored in Hermon."
"Around His house, the form and the fruit of the garden are uniquely delightful. There is also a place for wine and oil; it is truly beautiful; the fruit is of exquisite flavor."
"When a carnal man enters unto Him, he rises from the flavor of the fruit, and his soul is distinct from his flesh by the abundance of joy."
"And in that day, those kings who have done the will of the Lord shall rejoice; their work and their place shall be known in the kingdom of heaven, a place of eternal life."

"As their glory is on earth, so it is in heaven; thus it was shown on earth; and as they are honored on earth, so shall they be honored in heaven; they shall be exalted; and in this world, if they perform good works, they shall rejoice."

"Yet the kings who are evil in their dominion and their rule shall not be judged in truth and righteousness; for they have cried out against the poor and the needy, and they do not regard the fatherless and the widow, nor do they spare the one who has fallen and the one who is afflicted."

"They shall not be spared from the hand that oppresses the poor and the needy; they shall not be cleansed from their food that is defiled; they shall not be purified from their drink that is intoxicated; nor shall their mouths return to the cry of the destitute."

"And they shall be taken into the darkness of the abyss and into the dwelling of Sheol; for the Lord, the great creator, when His wrath has come upon them, David in his psalm said, 'O Lord, in Your anger do not rebuke me; and in Your wrath do not chastise me,' as it was spoken, so their multitude shall increase their troubles and their downfall shall be great."
"Kings and princes who rule this world shall take away those who do not keep Your law."

"But in heaven, there is God who rules over all; the soul of all is in His hand; the life of all is in His mouth; and He is the one who gives honor to those who honor Him; for He is able to do all things, and He possesses all, and He loves those whom He loves."
"He is the King of heaven and earth; He examines the heart and the mind; and to Him, the one who prays with a pure heart shall be given the value of his prayer."
"He shall destroy the pride of the mighty who do evil against the widows and orphans."

"This kingdom that you possess is not by your power; nor is it by your ability that you are seated upon this throne; but indeed, you are able to rule the people, and in that time, when your people are bought, you shall be like the word of the Lord and the word of Samuel, as if you had not destroyed the king of Amalek and his army, as Saul was judged, so shall you be judged in the kingdom upon the throne."

And the Lord sent His prophet Samuel, saying, "Go and proclaim the law, and destroy their idols; and as for their idols, cast them into the dust, for their works have brought sorrow upon me." Therefore, Saul went to the land of Amalek, and he utterly destroyed all that was there, from man to beast, and he killed all their kings and their armies.
Therefore, when the Lord was angered against them, He sent them away.

But He spared their king; and He spared much cattle, and women, and the good of the Amalekites. Therefore, the Lord spoke to His prophet Samuel, saying, "I have spoken, and I have not heeded My command; go and tell the kingdom that I have rejected it."
Upon him shall rest the spirit of the Lord, and he shall anoint David, the son of Jesse, to reign over Israel.
But He shall not be moved, for He shall be like a tree planted by the waters.

He who does My will shall be given the kingdom; but if he does not do My will, he shall be cast away. You, however, go and tell them this: "As I have spoken against your people, so shall I establish you upon the throne of the kingdom."
But you do not know the greatness of the honor and the grace that the Lord has bestowed upon you.
And the prophet Samuel went to the king, to Saul. He sat at the table, and as the king of Amalek was sitting on his left, he approached him.
"Why have you commanded me to destroy man and beast? Why have you not obeyed the command of the Lord?" he said.
At that time, the king arose from his throne; he took the garments of Samuel, and Samuel did not return; for the garments of Samuel were torn.
ሳሙኤልም ሳኦልን፦ እግዚአብሔር መንግሥትህን ከፈላት አለው።
ዳግመኛም ሳኦል ሳሙኤልን፦ በሕዝቡ ፊት አክብረኝ፤ ይቅር ይለኝም ዘንድ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ኀጢአቴን አስተስርይልኝ አለው፤ ሳሙኤልም ቃሉን ለመለወጥ እንቢ አለ። የፈጣሪውን እግዚአብሔርን ቃል ፈርትዋልና፥ የሚሞት ንጉሥን ግን አልፈራውምና።
ስለዚህም ነገር ያላመጠውን ሳይውጠው የአማሌቅ ንጉሥ አጋግን ወጋው።
የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል ያፈረሰ ያንም ዝንጉ ርኩስ መንፈስ ያዘው፤ ራሱንም መታው፤ እርሱ ሁሉን የሚያዝዝ ንጉሠ ነገሥት ስለሆነ እግዚአብሔር ዐመፅን ያደረገ ንጉሥን አያፍረውምና።
የማይፈሩት የነገሥታቱንና የመኳንንቱን ሥልጣን ሁሉ የሚሽር እርሱ የፍጥረቱ ሁሉ ጌታ ነውና እርሱን የሚያዝዘው የለም።
የዳዊት ወገን እየገነነ ይሄዳል፤ የሳኦል ወገን ግን እየተዋረደ ይሄዳል ብሎ እንደ ተናገረ ከሳኦልና ከልጁ መንግሥትን አጠፋ።
ስላሳዘነውና በክፉ ሥራቸው ያሳዘኑትን ወንጀለኞችን ስለ አላጠፋ እግዚአብሔር ተበቅሎ የሳኦልን ወገን አጠፋ። የእግዚአብሔርን ጠላት የማይበቀል ሰው እርሱ የእግዚአብሔር ጠላት ነውና።
መበቀል ሲቻለው፥ ሥልጣንም ሳለው ኀጢአተኛውን የማይበቀል፥ የእግዚአብሔር ሕግ የሌለውንም የማይበቀል ሰው እርሱ በእውነት የእግዚአብሔር ጠላት ነው።
"If you be a king, or if you be a ruler, what are you? Is not He who created you, the Lord God?"

"To do His will, you must walk in His command; and if you do not fear His judgment, He shall bring you to the place of judgment; as you chastise your servants, so shall you be chastised, and above you is the one who has been chastised."
"You who strike those who commit sin without mercy, so shall you also be struck; until the end of the world, there is no escape from judgment, and the Lord God shall add to your punishment."
"You who have not been redeemed, and whose hand has not been lifted up, why do you think you can escape the hand of the Lord?"
"Why do you not fear your God, the Lord, who loves you? He is the one who truly protects the people and the nation, for He is the one who created you and has spoken over all creation."
"The Lord shall judge you in truth and righteousness, and shall not show favoritism to the great or to the small; without Him, whom shall you fear? Keep His way and His command."
"I have offered you fire and water; do not be careless as Moses gathered the children of Israel, for do not let your right hand and your left hand be separated."

"When you hear the word, and when you do His command, listen to the word that I speak to you; whether in the sea, or in the deep, or in the river, the word is near; do not say, 'Who will bring it to me?'"
"If you say, 'Who will bring me the word of the Lord from heaven?' behold, the word is near your mouth; it is within your hand."
"If you have not heard the book, your God, the Lord, has not heard you; if you do not keep the word, He does not love you; and you have not done His command."
If thou dost not cherish the commandment, in truth thou shalt keep it, and if thou hast not made a covenant with thy kin, thou shalt be brought before judgment for eternity.

That thou should remember the name of thy God, which thou hast established above all the people, and as a ruler, thou hast made it known. In truth and in righteousness, thou hast given them their due.
There are those who shall pursue thee because thou art esteemed; while thou considerest the way of the Lord, and thy heart is made pure, thou shalt be guided in righteousness.
Before thee, in times of distress, do not turn away; for the earth is thine, and thou shalt judge the wicked, but the righteous shall be exalted; therefore, do not accept falsehood.
"If thou dost fulfill thy covenant, thy days upon the earth shall be prolonged; but if thou dost grieve us, thy days shall be shortened."
As thou risest from death, whether it be for good or for ill, consider all thy works before thee, as thou dost stand upright.
If thou dost perform good works, thou shalt dwell in the abodes of kings, in houses of light. But if thou dost perform evil works, thou shalt dwell among the wicked.

The Lord shall not take away thy power of nobility; but thou, in thy fear, shalt still behold the rewards of thy warriors, and the weapons of war that have been entrusted to thee, and thy horses, and all that is beneath thy authority, and those who dance in the fields, and those who play before thee.

Thou shalt elevate thy heart in all that thou seest; thou shalt also strengthen thy loins; and in all this, do not forget the honor that hath been bestowed upon thee; for in the time of thy presence, thou art not one to be disregarded.
The garment that thou dost wear shall be completed, and thy glory shall be given to another.
ድንገት ሞት ይመጣብሃልና፥ በትንሣኤም ጊዜ ፍርድ ይደረጋልና፥ የሰውም ሥራ ሁሉ ይመረመራልና በዚያ ይመራመርሃል፤ ይቈጣጠርሃልም፤ ይፈርድብሃልም።
የምድርን ነገሥታትም የሚያከብራቸው የለም፤ እርሱ የእውነት ዳኛ ስለሆነ በፍርድ ጊዜ ድሃና ባለጸጋ በአንድነት ይቆማሉና። የምድር መኳንንት የሚመኩበት ዘውዳቸው ይወድቃል።
“ፍርድ የተዘጋጀ ነው፤ ነፍስም ትንቀጠቀጣለች፤ መጻሕፍትም ይገለጣሉ፤ የሰዎችም ሥራ ይገለጣል፤ የሚሰወርም የለም።
ሴት ለመውለድ በደረሰች ጊዜ፥ በሆዷም ያለ ፅንስ ለመወለድ በደረሰ ጊዜ ማኅፀኗን ለመከልከል እንደማትችል ምድር በሙታን ትንሣኤ ጊዜ በርሷ ላይ ያለ አደራዋን ትመልሳለች።
ወይስ ደመናዎች እግዚአብሔር ወዳዘዛቸው ቦታ ወስደው እንዳያዘንሙ ዝናምን መቋጠር ይችላሉን? እንደዚሁም የእግዚአብሔር ቃል ሁሉን ካለመኖር ወደ መኖር አምጥቶ ፈጥሮታልና፥ ዳግመኛም የእግዚአብሔር ቃል ሁሉን ወደ መቃብር አግብቶታልና የትንሣኤ ጊዜ ከደረሰ በኋላ የሞቱ ሰዎች እንዳይነሡ ማድረግ አይቻልም።
ዳግመኛም ከእግዚአብሔር አፍ በሚወጣ ቃል ነው እንጂ ሰው የሚድን በእህል ብቻ አይደለም ብሎ ሙሴን እንደ ተናገረ የእግዚአብሔር ቃል ሰውን ሁሉ ከመቃብር ያስነሣዋል።
እነሆ የሞቱ ሰዎች በእግዚአብሔር ቃል ሕያዋን እንደሚሆኑ ታወቀ።
ዳግመኛም ስለ ነገሥታትና መኳንንት፥ ፈቃዱንም ስለሚያደርጉ ሰዎች እግዚአብሔር በዳግም ሕግ እንዲህ አለ፦ የሚቈጠሩበት ቀን ደርሷልና በፍርድ ቀን እግራቸው በሚሰናከልበት ጊዜ እበቀላቸዋለሁ።
“ዳግመኛም የእግዚአብሔርን ፍርድ የማያውቁ ሰዎችን እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ አላቸው፦ እኔ እግዚአብሔር እንደ ሆንሁ ዕወቁ፤ እኔ እገድላለሁ፥ አድናለሁም።
እቀሥፋለሁ፤ ይቅርም እላለሁ፤ ወደ ሲኦል አወርዳለሁ፤ ዳግመኛም ወደ ሰማይ አወጣለሁ፤ ከእጄም የሚያመልጥ የለም።

Because the rulers and the princes do not uphold the law, the Lord God has spoken thus: "The earthly kingdom is responsible, for it does not pass from dawn until dusk; and to My everlasting kingdom you shall enter, therefore keep My law and My commandments."
The call of the Lord is for glory and for honor; this He shall bestow; and that one shall be honored.
He shall punish the one who has not fulfilled his duty; and he shall reward the one who has fulfilled his duty.

"Concerning the resurrection of the dead, I shall speak unto thee; the trees shall be uprooted; their branches shall be cast forth; or the vine shall be taken away; for the Lord God shall bring forth its fruit, and from Him shall they pour out the wine."
"Until thou dost look, behold, this tree which thou didst plant was small. But now it bringeth forth branches, blossoms, and fruit."
"And the Lord God shall cause it to drink from two fountains, from water and from the earth."
"Yet its trees shall be nourished by the wind and by the sun; the earth shall water for the branch; and the earth shall give strength unto the trees."
"The breath which the Lord created shall give forth its fruit among them. The dead also shall rise again; such is the resurrection."
"The soul, when separated from the flesh, shall wander by itself, and from water and from the earth, from fire and from wind, shall gather the souls from the four corners."
"The earthly sea, indeed, is strong in itself; it hath become a pillar; and the sea of water is also strong in itself; it hath become a foundation."
"The sea of wind is also strong in itself; it hath become a breath; and the sea of fire is also strong in itself; even the consuming fire hath become."
"But the breath created by the Lord shall return unto its Creator; in the time of its return, it shall dwell in the place of its origin."
"The souls of the righteous shall dwell in the house of light; but the souls of the wicked shall be cast forth until the time of their return, and they shall dwell in the house of darkness."
"And the prophet said unto Ezekiel, Thus saith the Lord: Gather ye together and become one body, as it were, from the four corners of the earth."
"And thus it was spoken, in one word, they were gathered from the four corners of the earth."
"And the sea of water brought forth a flood; and the sea of fire brought forth a heat of flame."
"And the sea of the earth brought forth the earth; and the sea of the wind brought forth the breath."
"And the Lord brought forth the soul from its dwelling; they were gathered together in one word; and it was a resurrection."

"And again, I will show you a parable concerning thee; the day shall come, and thou shalt sleep; the night shall be drawn; and from thy sleep thou shalt arise; yet in thy sleeping time, thou art as one who is dead."
"In thy waking time, it is a parable of resurrection; but the night is a parable of the darkness of this world. The whole world shall sleep; for the darkness of the night hath overshadowed them."
"Where darkness shall be cast away, and in the world shall be light; and man shall arise and go to his work, yet the light of the resurrection of the dead is a parable."
"This is the resurrection of the dead and the end of the world; for this world is accountable for this night."
"And David also, as it was spoken, dwelt in the sun; as the sun arose and shone, this is the parable of the world."

Today in this world, as the sun shines, He, the Lord God, shall illuminate the new world that is to come; He shall shine like the sun; a sun that does not set, a light that does not fade, for I am He, and He, the Lord God, is its brightness.

The resurrector shall raise the dead as an eye awakens; likewise, as you dwell in life, I have brought you a single example from your sustenance: whether it be the grain of wheat, or the grain of barley, or the grain of millet, all that is sown upon the earth, if it does not perish, shall not be diminished.
As you see, as all flesh of man is to be consumed when the time comes, its fruit shall be eaten with the earth.

And when it is consumed, it shall be as a seventh hand of the grain; and the Lord shall give the breath of life as He desires; and the root shall be consumed in the earth; and the stalk shall be cast upon the earth.
Now behold; if it has not perished, it cannot be consumed; however, after it has been consumed, it shall be cast forth in great detail.
For the one who has sown, the Lord shall give fruit; and the fruit shall be as it is sown.
The seed that you have sown, as it increases in measure, behold, it shall not be diminished; its stalk, bright, its fruit and its yield shall not be counted against you.
"Do not be weary; behold your seed as it increases; likewise, consider the resurrection of all the dead, as their works shall be accounted."
The resurrector shall not change one seed for another; let me speak to you: if you sow wheat, shall you not gather barley? If you sow millet, shall you not gather teff?
If you plant a vine, shall it not yield grapes? If you plant a fig, shall it not yield figs?
Shall a sweet fruit, when it is planted, yield bitterness? And shall that which is bitter, when it is planted, yield sweetness?

Likewise, if a sinner dies, can he become righteous at the time of resurrection? And if a righteous man dies, can he become wicked at the time of resurrection? Each shall be rewarded according to his deeds; according to his works shall be his fruit, and as his hand hath done, so shall it be rewarded; there is no other sin for which he shall be judged.

The cedar of Lebanon shall be planted; it shall bring forth long and great branches; it shall be lofty and shall spread out, but if it be not watered by the dew of Hermon, its leaves shall not wither.
And the frost of winter, if it descend upon it, shall not cause it to wither from its root.
Likewise, all the dead shall not rise, if they have not descended from the life of God.
"The valleys of the Gilead and the mountains of Lebanon, if they do not receive mercy from the Lord, shall not yield their grass for the beasts and for the fowl."

"The mountains of Gilead and the valleys of Elam shall not provide for the lions and the goats, nor shall they give their sustenance to the wild beasts, the falcons, and the tortoises, nor to the swine."

"Thus, those who have previously committed sin and error, if they do not turn away from their iniquities and repent before the Lord, the merciful God, shall not rise from the dead; for the idols that they worship and the sins that they commit shall lead them to destruction, O Koros and Dimaso."
"The sins that they commit shall lead them to destruction, and they shall perform wicked deeds, and they shall harm men."
"Those who have departed from the law and trust in their idols, the men of Athens and the Medes, shall be led astray by their songs and their feasts, and they shall be led to destruction."

"In their idols they shall trust, and by their own hands they shall be led astray; in the time of resurrection, on the day of judgment, these are they who shall not be saved nor shall they be delivered."
"Do you not see, O you who are proud and haughty, that the dead shall not rise again?"
"In the resurrection of the dead, when the archangel Michael speaks, do not be like a fool, nor think thus."
"The mountains and the hills shall be brought low; the rivers and the valleys shall be exalted; the crooked paths shall be made straight."
"For all flesh, for every creature, there shall be a resurrection."

"If this were not so, why do the forefathers, beginning from Adam, including Abel and the woman, Noah and Shem, Abraham and Isaac, Jacob and Joseph, from Moses and Aaron, receive their burial outside their graves, for those whom they did not love?"

"Is it not so that at the time of resurrection, they shall rise in unity with their generations? Is it not so that their bodies shall not be counted with the wicked, with the idols of their gods and with the bodies of the heathens?"
"But you, having been buried together in one grave, how shall your bodies rise after death? Do not let your heart be troubled."
"And when you see the grave, know that the earth shall not be found full; how shall the dead rise? You shall speak this in your heart."
"Do you not say that the seed you have sown shall not perish? Indeed, the seed you have sown shall surely flourish."
"Thus, all shall hasten to rise, for the Lord shall bring forth their souls; He has brought man from non-existence to existence, and His word, the giver of life, shall not hinder their resurrection."
"The one who returns from existence to death shall return; and the one who returns from death to existence shall return."
"The Lord is able to give life and to raise up."

The Armon and its walls have fallen; and the Lord has raised them up as their sin and as the work of their hands have been lifted up, and they shall be cast down before the idols of Babylon and Edom, for in their childhood they have wrought until their maturity, and because of their idols and their sins, they are condemned, and Tyre and Sidon shall be brought low.

Therefore, for their abominations and their wickedness, for the idols they have made, the Lord shall bring them to desolation. And the daughters of Judah shall not be ashamed before their Creator, for they shall be cast down.
As for her, in the time of restoration, the fall of Jerusalem shall be revealed; for she has not been guided by the law and judgment of the Lord; yet, she has dwelt in joy and righteousness.
At that time, the Lord shall guide her with wisdom and light; in her childhood and all her works, and in her youth until her maturity, she shall be brought low by all her sins.

As they have dwelt in their iniquity and have disregarded the command of the Lord, so in the time of restoration shall they be brought low; as their forefathers did, they shall go to the grave; they shall be as a pillar.
Moses has spoken concerning them, saying, “Their place shall be as that of Sodom; their place shall be as the place of wine.”
Their sin is like that of Gomorrah; their likeness is like that of the sin of Hamor; their fruit is bitter.
And their wine is the poison of serpents; it is the venom of the cruel viper.”
O daughter of Jerusalem! This is your desolation, as it is written by the prophet; O daughter of Jerusalem! Your deeds and your iniquities are like those of Sodom and Gomorrah.
Your desolation is like that of Gomorrah and Sodom; their place is filled with bitterness and pride.

From bitterness and pride, from wickedness and iniquity, from bloodshed and the shedding of innocent blood, they have not remembered the name of their Creator, the Lord God, except for the lowliness and the mercy that has not been forgotten.
Apart from their evil deeds and their idols, they do not know their Creator, the Lord God; their works bring them joy; they are entangled with beasts and with men.

That their eyes may not see, they have been blinded; that they may not hear, their ears have been deafened to the will of the Lord God and to the things He loves, for their hearts are hardened; in their works they do not know the Lord God; they are as the place of Sodom, a vineyard of wickedness. Their lineage is like the fruit that has fallen, and they are like the wine of Gomorrah that cannot be gathered.
From the day it was planted, it has been rooted in bitterness; it has become a time of destruction, and when they gather their grapes, it shall be a time of judgment.
The vine of theirs has drunk the water of Sheol; their wine has been preserved in the winds of desolation, and always for their vine there is no goodness.
And when it is added, it becomes for destruction and for calamity; it has made the hearts of those who have drunk it to tremble; it shall cause them to tremble and to be troubled before the Lord God.
They shall dwell in their evil works, and it shall be a dwelling place for the devil; the wine of Sodom shall begin to be consumed; and they shall go to the mountains and to the trees.
Around her, she shall forsake the idols that they worship; she shall not know the evil and the good, and the daughters of the ungodly shall be made to suffer, both her daughters and her sons.
They shall cleanse the pure blood; they shall make a distinction from Sodom and shall cleanse it for its idols.
The gods of the Philistines shall be magnified, and the dragon that they worship shall be honored.

As they engage in their worship, fulfilling their desires from childhood until their youth, even to the time of their old age and until the day of their death, they shall always be the ones who are brought forth and cared for, so that they may not know their Creator, the Lord God, and their joy may be in their offerings, as they worship the things they have made.
In the time of their old age, I shall not return to my law, for they have not kept my commandment, and their time shall be until eternity.
If their gods are indeed true creators, in the time of my wrath, when I am angry with them, let their companions rise up with her and run to hell.
In my house and upon my holy altar, as she has made a sacrifice and an offering, so has she done in all things.
Behold, this is the house of the Lord; it is the dwelling place of the God of Israel; it is the sanctuary of the Most High; it is a city set apart, even Jerusalem, which is called by her name.
She is as my servant, and I am as her Lord; she shall trust in me; she shall not fear me as a thief, but she shall do my will.
To be cast away from me is to be a burden, but for those who do not come to me and do not seek me, for those who do not call upon me, she shall be sold to other gods.

She shall offer her sacrifices; she shall consume her offerings; she shall cleanse her offerings of drink; she shall drink of her offerings; she shall prepare her incense; she shall offer her incense; she shall take them; and she shall command them.
And the harlot shall cause her sons and her daughters to play the harlot; for their love is a thing of delight, and by her hand's work and by her mouth's speech, she shall bring joy.

Woe unto her in the day of judgment; for her lovers and her allies whom she hath loved, woe unto them; with them she shall say, and they shall not be able to escape, and the fire shall descend to the depths of the pit, and she shall descend to hell.
Thou hast cast me aside, O my Creator, and hast turned to other gods; woe unto thee, O daughter of Jerusalem.

I too shall bring forth my judgment upon thee; for thou hast caused me sorrow, and thy word hath been grievous unto me; and thy work I shall not remember, and as thy transgressions, I shall bring forth my vengeance.

Thou hast caused me sorrow with thy word, and thou shalt keep my commandment; and I too shall dwell with thee, and from all that oppress thee, I shall deliver thee; and thou shalt keep my commandment and my statutes; for my covenant with thee shall not be broken, and I shall be grieved; hastily I shall not forsake thee.

Yet all this thou shalt not keep; and I too shall be grieved; in the time of judgment, I shall bring forth my vengeance; am I not the one who created thee? Thou shalt not keep my word and my commandment; and my kin shall be honored by thee.
As Sodom and Gomorrah were separated, so hast thou separated thyself from me.

I have destroyed them in my wrath; and if I have destroyed them, thou art as one of Sodom and Gomorrah; and as the wife of Lot, when she looked back, thou hast mingled with the wicked, and with the beasts and the men, thou hast transgressed the law; for they have caused me sorrow, and I have blotted out their name from the earth that they may not rejoice in their joy.

From their least to their greatest, they do not fear God before them; in every evil deed they shall be delivered, but she shall not cease from her work; one shall not accuse the other; for their work is evil, and they are those who have turned away from righteousness and from sin.
Every evil deed is a snare and a trap; and it is prepared in their hearts.

Therefore, the Lord has made them desolate; He has laid waste their cities; they shall be burned with fire even to their foundations, and they shall be consumed until the end of the age, and not one of them shall remain.

For they are taken captive by sin, and until the judgment of the world is given, until the great day of judgment, they shall remain; for their evil deeds have caused me sorrow, and I shall not remember them; they shall not be forgiven.

I have not made them desolate; likewise, you, O daughter of Jerusalem, shall be taken captive on the day of judgment, for all your works are iniquity and sin, deceit and falsehood; and I, being one who does not love the way of error and deceit, shall not find you when I seek you.
I was for your honor; but you have made yourself a cause of downfall; I was for myself, but you have become for another.
I was for holiness; but you have become for the devil; and as for me, according to your deeds, I shall punish you.

Since you have not heeded my voice, and in the time I loved you, you did not keep my command, I am the Lord who created you, and I shall multiply evil upon you; as you are, I shall bring judgment upon you on the day of judgment.
And since you do not heed my voice, I shall declare my judgment against you, and I shall punish you along with them.
In your hearts, you have no fear of the Lord, O Sodom and Gomorrah; woe unto you!

O daughter of Jerusalem, like your sister who is destined to perish in the fire of hell, woe unto you! For you shall descend together with her into the abyss prepared for eternity, and all who have done your works, woe unto them!
You have not kept my voice and my command; you and she who has not kept my voice and my command shall descend together into Sheol on the day of judgment.

The righteous who keep My commandments and My statutes shall feed upon the strength of the wicked; for the wicked shall be consumed as the chaff before the wind, and the righteous and the meek shall rejoice. They shall also be filled with gladness.
But the wicked and the unrighteous shall be cast away; for they have turned aside from My commandments, and in their wickedness they shall be ensnared.
He who keeps My word and walks in My commandments shall find My blessing; and he who honors Me shall be esteemed in My sight.
He who keeps My word and performs My commandments shall eat of the blessings of the earth; and the meek and the humble shall dwell in the place prepared for them.
In the time of My wrath, they shall be cast down, and they shall be consumed; for today, all those who are a burden to themselves, to Tyre and Sidon, and to the regions of Judah, woe unto them.

The Lord saith, “The proud and the arrogant, the children of destruction, who oppress the righteous, and know not their Creator, shall be cast out from among them; for the Almighty God shall reveal His power upon them, and I have made them a parable for My wrath.”

These are the inhabitants of Samaria and Galilee, of Syria and Damascus, of Cyprus and Achaia, and all the regions of Jordan; they have been oppressed, they walk in their wickedness, and death and darkness have covered them; for the devil has seized their hearts, and therefore the proud shall be bound, and they shall not return unto the Lord.

Woe unto them who are bound, for they shall be consumed by their own works; for their Creator, the Lord God, has turned away from them, and they are like beasts without understanding; for the son of destruction shall stand in every place, and in his hand and in his heart, in all his desires and in all his sins, in wickedness and in evil, in all that he does, he shall find delight in falsehood.
This shall be done according to the decree of the Lord, for it is known that this is how it shall be accomplished in His time.

The sun shall be darkened; the moon shall become as blood; and the stars from heaven shall fall; for within her, the people shall work to measure the earth, and all that is within her shall be laid waste; in the latter days, all the works of wonder shall perish.
The Lord has turned His face upon the creation He has made; in one hour, as it has been decreed, the last enemy, death, shall be swallowed up.
The Almighty God hath said, “I shall bring forth my strength,” and after that, there shall be no power.

He shall be kept on the day of My wrath, and he shall descend to the land, to the sanctuary and to judgment; all those who are with him shall be cast into destruction, into misery and into calamity; for I am he who brings forth from hell both judgment and deliverance.
He shall give strength and power to the weary, and to the weak He shall grant vigor; for the mighty shall not prevail by their might.
እርሱ እግዚአብሔር ገዢ ነውና፥ የሚበድሉትንም ሰዎች ከሚበድሏቸው ሰዎች እጅ ፈርዶ ያድናቸዋልና የባልቴቶችንና የሙት ልጆችን በቀል ይመልሳል።
ለምትመኪ፥ አንገትሽንም ለምታደነድኚ ለአንቺ ወዮልሽ፤ በቍጣዬ የማልይዝሽና የማልበቀልሽ፥ ይመስልሻል፤ እንዲህ ተብሎ እንደ ተነገረ፥ “በጧት የሚወጣ የአጥቢያ ኮከብ ከሰማይ ለምን ወደቀ?
በትዕቢቱና በትምክሕቱ ዙፋኔን በሰማያትና በከዋክብት ላይ እዘረጋለሁ፤ እንደ ልዑልም እሆናለሁ” ብሏልና።
ይኸንም በትዕቢትህ ደፍረህ ተናገርህ፤ በእጁ የፈጠረህንና የሠራህን እግዚአብሔርንም አላሰብኸውም፤ በልቡናህ ጽናት ወደ ገሃነም ትወርድ ዘንድ አንተ ራስህን ለምን ከፍ ከፍ አደረግህ?
እንደ አንተም ከአሉ መላእክት ሁሉ በትዕቢትህ ተዋረድህ፤ እነርሱ በልብ ትሕትና ፈጣሪያቸውን ያመሰግኑታልና፥ ከትእዛዙም አይወጡምና የፈጠራቸውና የሠራቸውም እርሱ እንደ ሆነ አውቀዋልና፥ ከትእዛዙም እንዳይወጡና እንዳይተላለፉ ሕሊናቸውን ጠበቁ።
አንተ ግን በልቡናህ ትዕቢት ክፉን አደረግህ፤ ከጓደኞችህም ተለይተህ የተዋረድህ ሆንህ፤ እንደ አንተ ያሉ ኃጥኣንና ከአንተ ፍጥረት ወገን የሆኑ፥ እንደ አንተም የሚክዱ ዝንጉዎች ለሚኖሩበት ኀጢአትና በደል፥ ሽንገላና ቅሚያ ሁሉ አንተ ጠባቂው ነህና ክፋትን የምታስተምራቸው፥ በፈቃድህና በትእዛዝህ ይሔዳሉ።
አንተና በተንኰልህ ያሳትሃቸው በአንድነት ወደ ገሃነም ትወርዳላችሁና ወዮልህ።
በሚያስት በዚያ በወንጀለኛ የሳታችሁ የእግዚአብሔር ልጆች ሆይ፥ ወዮላችሁ! እርሱና አጋንንቱ በአስተማሯችሁ እንደ እርሱ ስታችኋልና ለዘለዓለም መውጫ ወደሌለበት መቅሠፍት በአድነት ትወርዳላችሁ።
ቀድሞም የእግዚአብሔር ባሪያ ሙሴ ሳለ በኮሬብና በክርክር ውኃ፥ በደብረ ሲናና በአማሌቅ አሳዘናችሁት።
ዳግመኛም ወደ ከነዓን ጕበኛ በላካችሁ ጊዜ ጎዳናው ሩቅ ነው፤ እስከ ሰማይ የሚደርስ ቅጽራቸውም፥ አንባቸውም ጽኑ ነው፤ አርበኞችም በዚያ ይኖራሉ ብለው ይህን በነገሩአችሁ ጊዜ የሚያስጨንቅ ሥራ ወደምትሠሩበት ወደ ግብፅ ሀገር ትመለሱ ዘንድ ተቈጥታችሁ በእግዚአብሔር ቃል ዐመፃችሁ።
ከመከራው ያዳናችሁን፥ በግብፅም ታላላቅ ተአምራትን አድርጎ በመልአኩ እጅ የመራችሁን እግዚአብሔርን አላሰባችሁትም። ፀሐይ እንዳያቃጥላችሁ ቀን በደመና ይጋርዳችሁ ነበር፥ እግራችሁም በጨለማ እንዳይሰናከል ዐምደ እሳት በሌሊት ያበራላችሁ ነበር።
ሠራዊቱና ፈርዖንም ባስፈሯችሁ ጊዜ ፈጽማችሁ ወደ ሙሴ ጮኻችሁ፤ ሙሴም ፈጽሞ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ጮኸ፤ ከፈርዖንም ሠራዊት ጋር እንዳትገናኙ በመልአኩ ጠበቃችሁ።
እነርሱን ግን በመከራ መለሳቸው። “እግዚአብሔር ብቻውን መራቸው፤ ከእነርሱም ጋር ሌላ አምላክ አልነበረም” ብሏልና። ጠላቶቻቸውን ግን አንድ ጊዜ በባሕር ቀበራቸው፤ ከእነርሱም የሚሸሸውን አላስቀረም።
እስራኤልንም በባሕሩ መካከል በእግር አሻገራቸው። ከግብፃውያንም የተነሣ ያገኛቸው ክፋት ምንም የለም። ወደ ደብረ ሲናም አደረሳቸው፤ በዚያም አርባ ዘመን መናውን መገባቸው።
የእስራኤል ልጆች እግዚአብሔርን ሁልጊዜ ያሳዝኑታልና ይህን ያህል መልካምን አድርጎላቸው እግዚአብሔርን ማምለክን ቸል አሉ።

ከልጅነታቸውም ጀምሮ እስኪያረጁ ድረስ ክፋትን በልቡናቸው አኖሩ። የእግዚአብሔር አንደበት በአበው የትውልድ መጽሐፍ እንደዚህ ብሎ ተናግሯልና፤ “የአዳም ልጆች ልቡናቸው ዐመድ ነው፤ ሥራቸውም ሁሉ ወደ ቅሚያና ወደ ክፋት መሮጥ ነው፤ ከእነርሱም በግፍ የሰውን ገንዘብ ከመሰብሰብ፥ በሐሰትም ከመማል፥ ባልንጀራውንም ከመግደል፥ ከመቀማትና ከመስረቅ በቀር የቀናች ሥራን የሚወዳት የለም።
ሁሉም በሕይወት ዘመናቸው ወደዚህ ክፋት ይሄዳሉ፤” የእግዚአብሔርን ትእዛዝ ያፈረሱ የእስራኤል ልጆችም ከመጀመሪያ እስከ መጨረሻ ድረስ እግዚአብሔርን ፈጽመው አሳዘኑት።
And the Lord, because of the sin of the children of Cain, did not allow the earth to be seen in the time of their destruction by water; He did not cleanse all the sins of the children of Cain.

"I have grieved for the man whom I have created," He said, and He destroyed all the wicked; He left not one of the eight men; He destroyed them all. After this, He cursed them; He caused the earth to perish; they shared in the inheritance of their father Adam.

But Noah found favor in the sight of the Lord, and the Lord made a covenant with him, that the earth would not be destroyed again by water; and that his children would not perish nor be consumed, that they would not worship other gods besides the Lord their God, and that He would be their God, lest they be destroyed even once, and that they would not be afflicted by famine and drought, and that He would provide for them food at all times, and that He would give them their harvest and the fruits of their fields, so that they would serve the Lord in all that He delights, and they made a covenant.

And after He gave them this law, the children of Israel provoked the Lord in their rebellion. They did not keep the law of their Creator, just as their fathers did not, like Abraham and Isaac, and they did not follow Jacob.
From the least of them to the greatest of them, those who did not keep the law of the Lord, these children of Israel were in their works as the swine.
Even their priests, their leaders, and their scribes, all of them transgressed the law of the Lord.
And Moses commanded them in the book of the law, saying, "You shall not be distressed by the law and the ordinance of the Lord." "With all your heart and with all your soul, love the Lord your God;
Love your neighbor as yourself; do not worship other gods; do not go to the wife of your neighbor; do not kill your soul; do not steal."
Do not bear false witness; do not covet your neighbor's money, nor your brother's possessions, whether it be a donkey or an ox, do not covet.

But indeed, after all these things, the wicked children of Israel turned to sin and to iniquity, to wickedness and to deceit, to the wife of their neighbor and to the east, to falsehood and idols, and to the worship of them they will return.
የእስራኤል ልጆች ወደ ሣር የሚሠማራ የላምን ጣዖት በመሥራት በኮሬብ እግዚአብሔርን አሳዘኑት፤ “እነሆ፥ ከግብፅ ያወጡን አማልክቶቻችን እነዚህ ናቸው” ብለው ሰገዱ።
በእጃቸውም ሥራ ደስ አላቸው፤ በሉ፥ ጠጡ፤ ጠገቡም፤ ሊዘፍኑም ተነሡ።
ስለዚህ እግዚአብሔር “ከግብፅ ሀገር ከባርነት ቤት ያወጣሃቸው ወገኖችህ በደሉ፥ ሳቱም፤ የላም ምስልም ሠርተው ለጣዖቱ ሰገዱ” ብሎታልና ሙሴ ተቈጥቶ ከሲና ተራራ ወረደ።
ሙሴም ወገኖቹን እየተቈጣቸው ከባለሟሉ ከኢያሱ ጋራ ወረደ፤ ኢያሱም በሰማ ጊዜ “እነሆ፥ በእስራኤል ሰፈር ያርበኞችን ድምፅ እሰማለሁ” አለ።
ሙሴም ኢያሱን እንዲህ አለው “ያልፈላ የወይን ጠጅ ድምፅ እንጂ ያርበኛስ ድምፅ አይደለም።” ወርዶም ምስላቸውን ሰበረው፤ እንደ ትቢያም እስኪሆን ድረስ ፈጽሞ አደቀቀው፤ የእስራኤልም ልጆች በተራራው አጠገብ በሚጠጡት ውኃ ውስጥ ጨመረው።
ከዚህ በኋላ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ክፉ ስለ አደረጉ እርስ በርሳቸው ይጋደሉ ዘንድ ሌዋውያንን አዘዛቸው።
ራሳቸውን ከመግደል፥ ዘመዶቻቸውንና አባቶቻቸውንም ከመግደል እግዚአብሔርን መገዳደር እንደሚበልጥ ዐውቀው እንዳዘዛቸው አደረጉ።
ስለዚህም ሙሴ እንዲህ አላቸው፥ “የመገባችሁንና የተከባከባችሁን፥ ከአገዛዝም ቤት የአወጣችሁን፥ ለእነርሱና ከእነርሱ በኋላ ለልጆቻቸው ይሰጣቸው ዘንድ ላባቶቻችሁ የማለላቸው ርስትንም ያወረሳችሁ እግዚአብሔርን ስላሳዘናችሁት በእጃችሁ እግዚአብሔርን ደስ አሰኛችሁት።”
ከዚያም ወደ ኀጢአትና ወደ ክፉ ነገር ይሄዳሉና እግዚአብሔርን ማሳዘንን አልተዉም።

ከሕፃንነታቸው ጀምረው እስከ ጐልማሳነታቸውና እስከ እርጅናቸው ድረስ በምድር ላይ ያለውን፥ በሰማይም ለሚወዱት ያዘጋጀውን ይሰጣቸው ዘንድ በበጎ ሥራቸው እግዚአብሔርን ደስ እንዳሰኙት እንዳባቶቻቸው እንደ አብርሃምና እንደ ይስሐቅ እንደ ያዕቆብም አይደሉም፤ በዚህም ወተትና ማር የምታፈስሰውን ምድረ ርስትን፥ በወዲያውም ዓለም ለጻድቃን የተዘጋጀች የደስታ ገነትን፥ ዐይን ያላየውን፥ ጆሮም ያልሰማውን፥ በሰው ልቡናም ያልታሰበውን፥ እግዚአብሔርን በሕይወታቸው ደስ ላሰኙት ለሚወዱት ለአብርሃምና ለይስሐቅ ለያዕቆብም እግዚአብሔር ያዘጋጀውን ይሰጣቸው ዘንድ፤
But the children of those who are wicked and have a heart filled with evil do not listen to the word of the Lord, which they have been entrusted with since their infancy.
They did not remember the Lord, who brought them out of the land of Egypt, nor did they consider the work of His hands, nor the bitter toil He delivered them from.
Yet they greatly distressed Him; for He was the one who raised up nations around them; and they, rising in enmity, would ensnare them as they desired.

And at that time, the people of Midian rose up in hostility; they also sent their armies against Israel, and their king was called Acrandios; many soldiers from Syria and from the region of Cilicia, and from Damascus, gathered together for battle.

And he also departed from Jordan; and thus he sent messengers to Israel, saying, “Pay tribute to me; otherwise, I will come against you, and I will take your possessions, and all your wealth, and your children I will take.”
And to the land which you do not know, I will take you; and there I will provide water for your cattle and wood for your dwellings.

We are the people of the Lord; do not say to us, “There is nothing we can do,” lest you perish, for the Lord has not sent me to you to take away your wealth? I have come to gather all that belongs to you.
Am I not the one who has taken away the other nations, their unique idols? I have taken their wealth and their cries; I have destroyed them, and I have taken their children.

Thus, as I have commanded you, if you do not pay tribute, I will deal with you as I have dealt with them.” He will take their possessions and their wealth, and their wives and their children, and he fled across the Jordan.
After this, the children of Israel cried out bitterly to the Lord; they cried out, but there was none to help them.
Therefore, to the three brothers, the Lord gave strength; and their names were as follows: Mebukiyus, Mekabisen, and Judah. Their goodness was great, and they were all mighty men of valor.

And when the children of Israel cried out, at that time, a great cry arose from all the children of Israel; it grieved their hearts; for their wives and their dead children, their priests and their ministers, the entire lineage of Israel, both men and women, and all their children were in great distress; they were mourning for their dead.
But those good and noble brothers, they conspired to go and rescue them, saying, “Let us give our lives for these people.” Thus, they joined together.
Behold! Behold! They shall be gathered, and with their swords they shall be armed, and with their hands they shall take up their weapons; let them prepare and go forth to engage the enemy.

And while they were seated in the midst, they arrived; and the mighty one smote the enemy; and without having been wounded, in one of those years, he broke their necks; and Judah and Maccabeus also smote those who were on the left and on the right of their king with the sword.
And when their king fell, all fled; their swords entered into the hearts of their enemies; their shields were shattered; and they arose in victory.

But those brethren who were good and righteous, they were delivered; for there was no evil thing found among them; and the Lord returned to them His mercy, and those evils were turned back upon themselves.

They arose in victory; and death; and until they crossed the Jordan, they seized all their wealth; and all that belonged to them remained; and the children of Israel, as they fled and went to their dwelling, saw that they had taken the money that had been left behind.
And the Lord, by the hand of the mighty and of the brethren, did thus to the children of Israel.
And the children of Israel rejoiced in the Lord, and they dwelt a few days.
But afterward they returned again to their wickedness; and the children of Israel did not cease to praise the Lord as they ought.

But he, indeed, returned to his wickedness, and he did not know their harvest; and as they gathered their grapes and as they trampled their wine, they did not care for their vineyard, and they neglected their cattle before them.

Their wives, and their sons, and their daughters were afflicted by their enemies. Always, because they grieved the Lord, they were those who transgressed His law, and their children were made to suffer before them; they could not help them.
የጢሮስና የሲዶና ሕዝብ በባሕሩ ዳርቻና በዮርዳኖስ ወንዝ ማዶ ፥ በገለዓድና በካራን፥ በከናኔዎንና በኢያቡሴዎን፥ በጌርጌሴዎንና በኤዶም የሚኖሩ፥ የአማሌቅም ሕዝብ፥
አሕዛብም ሁሉ በየሀገራቸውና በየነገዳቸው፥ በየሥርዐታቸውና በየአውራጃዎቻቸው፥ በየሀገራቸውም ቋንቋ፥ ሁሉም እግዚአብሔር እንደ ወሰናቸው ይኖራሉ።
ከእነርሱም ሥራቸው ያማረና እግዚአብሔርን የሚያውቁት አሉ።
ከእነርሱም ሥራቸው ክፉ የሆነ፥ የፈጠራቸው እግዚአብሔርንም የማያውቁት አሉ፤ እንደ ሥራቸውም በሶርያው ንጉሥ በአሜኔሴር እጅ ገዛቸው፤
የደማስቆን ገንዘብ ይወስዳልና፥ በግብፁ ንጉሥ ፊትም የሰማርያን ምርኮ ይካፈላልና።
የገለዓድ ተራሮችና የጌላቡሄ ሸለቆዎች፥ ሰማርያና በይሁዳ ምድር ያለ ጳንጦስም ሁሉ፥ በዐረብ በሜድና በጳርቴ፥ በሴላውግያና በቀጶዶቅያ ተራሮች የሚኖሩ፥
በአውራጃቸውም የሚኖሩ፥ እግዚአብሔርንም የማያውቁና ትእዛዙን የማይጠብቁ አንገተ ደንዳና ሕዝብ ናቸው።
እርሱም እንደ ሥራቸው ክፋትና እንደ እጃቸው ሥራ ይከፍላቸዋል።
የቂሳርያ አውራጃ፥ የገለዓድና የአማሌቅ ሕዝብ፥ ጽድቅን የተመላች፥ በውስጧም የእስራኤል ቅዱስ፥ በኪሩቤል ሠረገላ ላይ የሚቀመጥ፥ እጅግ የብዙ ብዙ የሆኑ መላእክት በፊቱ የሚቆሙ የሠራዊት ጌታ የሚመሰገንባት የእግዚአብሔርን ከተማ ያጠፏት ዘንድ ተባብረዋልና።

The armies of Edom and Amalek do not regard the Lord, who holds the power of heaven and earth in His hand; for they are truly wicked men who do not walk in righteousness, and they do not fear to desecrate the house of the Lord.

From the dead and the shedding of blood, the one who has been struck and the one who has caused death, they do not fear the Lord before them, except for the food they consume; and they are those who have been awakened and have been revived.

They have neither faith nor understanding; they are those who pursue good works; and they do not know the Lord; for apart from wickedness and wrongdoing, from all evil deeds and violence, their fathers, the Sabellians, have taught them that they do not know the way of peace, except for singing and playing.

For He has made them to be like their own kind; for every evil work that is theirs, wickedness and deceit, the taking of another's wealth by violence and robbery, the death they have caused and the food of the one who has been struck and the dead they have taught them.

All that resembles this, the going to the wife of a neighbor, the shedding of blood, the food of the slain for idols, the killing of a human soul by violence, the stealing and oppression, the deceit and all wicked works that the Lord does not love, they have taught them; and this teaching has led the whole world away from the way of the Lord, that their enemies, the Sabellians, may bring them to ruin.
But the way of the Lord is humility and truth, and it is to forsake one's neighbor and not to harm a brother, and to be at peace with all men.

Before men, they are those who are cruel, to the weak and the helpless, to the neighbors and the wives of their neighbors; they commit violence and wicked deeds against their neighbors, and they are those who will be judged by the Lord for their neighbor's sake.
They will be punished; they will also be tormented; they will be given over to wickedness; and they will be brought before the eternal judgment of men to be made a spectacle.
And as you go unto the Lord, consider; all is in His hand; you shall stand before Him, for He shall judge you according to your works.

In times past, there were indeed wicked and proud ones, and among them there was none greater or stronger; the children of the wicked were thus; they did not regard the Lord before them, for they saw their strength and stature, and the might of their arms, yet they did not know that He was their Creator who brought them forth.
Their fathers, while angels were present, used to give thanks together with the angels in the heavens. Their will, in their time of grace, descended unto the judgment of everlasting punishment.
And the sons of men took wives; for their hearts were filled with pride, and they did not keep the law and the commandments, and thus the Lord created the flesh of man.

But they did not keep the command; and He cast them down with their fathers, along with the devil, into the fire of hell; and the Lord, as a man, has cast down the rebellious angels, and for their sake, the age of man was diminished.
The children of Adam were taken along with them; and by their punishment, they were cast down to Sheol.
The angels, by the word, have been diminished because of the sons of men; the ancient age of man was nine hundred years, and it has returned to one hundred twenty years.
And the Lord said, “They are flesh and blood, and My spirit shall not dwell in them.”

Therefore, our age has been diminished; and again, because of our wickedness and our sins, our age has been reduced from that of our forefathers, and there are those who die while they are still children.
But in the age of our fathers, because they kept the command, and because they did not provoke the Lord, they were greatly blessed.
And they taught them that the women should circumcise their sons; and that the men should circumcise their sons, lest they transgress the command of the Lord.
Therefore, because they did not uphold the command of the Lord together with their sons, both of the men and of the women, truly their days were filled with sorrow.
And the children of Cain, in great numbers, engaged in merriment and entertainment, playing games and singing songs.

And the wife of Abel was fair to behold, and because of her, the righteous Abel was slain; and the daughters of the fair ones were born unto Cain; and after his brother was slain, he took her unto himself; for she was his.
And they took their leave from their father and journeyed westward towards the cliffs of Kephas; and the children of that fair one were as their mother, fair in countenance.
Therefore, the angels descended unto the children of Cain; and not even for an hour did they delay, but they took for themselves wives from among them.
Thus, because of their transgressions, they were led into error together, and the Lord God was angry with us and with them.
And the devil said, "As your Creator, you shall be as gods," and he led our father Adam and our mother Eve into error.
Yet they, in their stubbornness, turned away from the truth, and they did not give glory to the holy name; and because they did not dwell in the presence of their Creator, they forsook His command.
Those who made wealth for themselves, He cast down; for He is their Lord, and He brought down the proud.
David said, "The proud in their iniquity shall be brought low," as our father Adam spoke, for he was judged in truth by God because of the pride of the devil.
Likewise, the angels of the Lord went unto the children of Cain concerning their transgressions. Therefore, the Lord diminished our days from the days of our fathers.

But they were engaged in good works; evil did not come near them; for their hearts were set upon the Lord, and they instructed their children, both sons and daughters, that they should not turn aside from the command of the Lord.
Yet, if they performed good works and did not instruct their children, nor teach them what would benefit them, it was of no avail.

David said, "They did not turn away from their children to another generation; they taught the glory of the Lord, His might and His wonders; they instructed their children as they were reminded, that they might remember and do, and that the judgment of the Lord might be upon them, that in their manner of living they might please the Lord, as their fathers did, and keep His command."
In their infancy, they learned to fear the Lord and His judgment, just as their fathers had taught them; their fathers did not forsake the command that was entrusted to them.
Their children also learned to honor their Creator, that they might give Him glory, as they were taught by their fathers; for they kept the law, and He was their refuge.
He also hears their prayers; He does not turn away their supplication; yet He is gracious and merciful.
His anger also turns away; in all His holy assembly, it was never extinguished.
And our brethren, consider; the Lord shall preserve the righteousness of those who do good works, as He has previously spoken unto you, do not forget.
Upon the earth, their fruit shall abound; their name shall be remembered for good until the end of the age; their seed shall not be consumed upon the earth.

For He shall take care of them, and in the hand of their adversaries, He shall not allow them to be harmed; from all their oppressors and from those who seek to harm them, His hand shall deliver them.
Their name shall be a help to those who love them in the time of their affliction; He shall preserve them; and all their sins He shall forgive them.
ዳዊት በእግዚአብሔር ተአመነ፤ በእርሱም አምኗልና መጠጊያ ሆነው፤ ከንጉሡ ከሳዖልም እጅ አዳነው።
ልጁ አቤሴሎምም በተነሣበት ጊዜ፥ ኢሎፍላውያንም በተነሡበት ጊዜ፥ አማሌቃውያንና ኤዶማውያን፥ ቀርኒዎናውያንም በተነሡበት ጊዜ በእርሱ አምኗልና፥ ሕጉንም ጠብቋልና ከተቃወሙት ጠላቶቹ ሁሉ እግዚአብሔር ዳዊትን አዳነው።
ያላመኑበትን ክፉ የሆኑ ነገሥታትን ግን እግዚአብሔር አላዳናቸውም፤ ድል መንሣት ከእግዚአብሔር ነውና በጠላቶቻቸው እጅ ድል ተነሡ እንጂ።
ሕዝቅያስም በእግዚአብሔር አመነ፤ ከትዕቢተኛው ከአሶራዊውም እጅ አዳነው።
ልጁ ምናሴ ግን እምነቱን በእግዚአብሔር አላደረገምና በጠላቱ እጅ ድል ተነሣ፤ ምናሴን ድል የነሡት እነዚያ ጠላቶቹም እንደ እርሱ አልሆኑም፤ መታመኑን በእግዚአብሔር አላደረገምና፥ ፈጽሞ ያከበረውና ያገነነው እግዚአብሔርንም አልፈራውምና አስረው ወደ ሀገራቸው ወሰዱት እንጂ፤
ዘመኑ ይበዛ ዘንድ፥ ጠላቱንም ይከራከርለት ዘንድ በኋላና በፊትም ኀይልንና ጽንዕን ይሆነው ዘንድ በፈጣሪው በእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ መንገዱን አላሣመረምና ከሰጠው ሀብት ከለከለው።
በብዙ ሠራዊትና በፈረሶች፥ በቀስትና በጋሻም ከመታመን በእግዚአብሔር መታመን ይሻላልና።
በእርሱም የታመነ ሰው በሕይወት ይኖራል፤ ይከብራል፤ ፈጽሞም ከፍ ከፍ ይላል።
እግዚአብሔር ለፊት አያዳላምና በእግዚአብሔር ያላመኑና፥ በገንዘባቸው ብዛት ያመኑ ሰዎች ግን ከሰጣቸው ጸጋና ክብር የወጡ ይሆናሉ።
ያመኑበትን ግን ይጠብቃቸዋል፤ ዐላዋቂ የሚሉትን ሰዎች ግን ዐላዋቂዎች ያደርጋቸዋል፤ እግዚአብሔርንም ለመከተል፥ ሕጉንም ለመጠበቅ ልቡናቸውን አላስጨከኑምና በመከራቸው ጊዜና ጠላቶቻቸው በተቃወሙአቸው ጊዜ ፈጥኖ አይረዳቸውም።
To follow the Lord God and to keep His commandments and His laws is a refuge in times of trouble.

By slaying the enemy and by consuming the enemy's livestock, by destroying the enemy's land and man, by seizing the glory of the ages, by gathering the fruits of the harvest, and by partaking in the bounty of the field.

In the season of the harvest and in the abundance of the fruits, by offering their grain and their offerings, may those who are beneath their hands rejoice, for by giving various fruits, joy has been brought forth.

Let them consume the weakness of another, and let them gather wealth from their enemies, let them raise livestock, sheep, and goats, let them wear the garments of another, and let them take the children of their enemies as their own, for joy has been brought forth.
And the Lord shall do all this for those who love Him; but for the enemy, He shall bring forth great destruction.

He shall make their hands and feet to stumble; and in the hands of their enemies, they shall fall; for He shall bring forth their punishment, and the law of the Lord shall be broken, and blood shall be shed, and joy shall not be found in their house.
In the time of judgment, they shall not escape; for to the wicked doers, He shall repay evil in the time of their deeds, and He shall recompense the fruit of their works.
But to those who do good, He shall reward them with good, and man shall keep them in his hand as commanded by the Lord.

And he shall keep His commandments, for he is commanded; and he shall do His will, and he shall give thanks to the Lord who created him, for he is a servant over all creation, and there is no commandment of the Creator that is not conveyed to every living being except for man.
All shall know; for the Lord shall keep all who dwell in their ordinances as He has commanded them in His commandments and in His law.
ሰው ግን በአራዊትና በእንስሳ፥ በአዕዋፍም፥ በፍጥረቱም ሁሉ በአነገሠው በእግዚአብሔር ላይ ይደፋፈራል።

በባሕር ያለውን፥ በየብስ ያለውንም ሁሉ ቢሆን የፈጠረውን ፍጥረት ሁሉ እግዚአብሔር ለአባታችን ለአዳም ሰጠው፤ የወደደውን ያደርግ ዘንድ፥ በምድርም እንደ እህል ይበላቸው ዘንድ፥ ይገዛቸውና ያሠራቸውም ዘንድ፥ አራዊትም ቢሆኑ፥ እንስሳትም ቢሆኑ ለሰው ይታዘዙ ዘንድ እግዚአብሔር ሰጣቸው፤ የነገሡ ሰዎችም ክብርን ለሰጣቸው ለእግዚአብሔር ይታዘዙ ዘንድ፥ ያደሉለትና ይታዘዙለት ዘንድ በፍጥረቱ ሁሉ ላይ ሾማቸው።
ከሕጉ ቢወጡ ግን እርሱ ከሰጣቸው ሀብት ይለያቸዋል፤ ሰማይንና ምድርን የሚገዛ ነውና ፈቃዱን ለሚያደርግ ይሰጠዋል።
የወደደውን ይሾመዋል፤ የወደደውንም ይሽረዋል፤ ይገድላል፤ ያድናልም፤ ይገርፋል፤ ይቅርም ይላል።
እንደ እርሱ ያለ ሌላ የለም፤ ለፈጠረው ፍጥረት ሁሉ እርሱ ጌታ ነውና የሚነቅፈው የለም፤ በላይ በሰማይ፥ በታችም በምድር ከእርሱ በቀር ሌላ አምላክ የለም።
ይሾማል፤ ይሽራልም፤ ይገድላል፤ ያድናልም፤ ይገርፋል፤ ይቅር ይላልም፤ ያደኸያል፤ ያበለጽጋልም።
የሚለምኑትን ልመናቸውን ይቀበላል፤ በንጹሕ ልቡና ፈቃዱን የሚያደርጉትንም እርሱ ጸሎታቸውን ይሰማቸዋል፤ በለመኑትም ሁሉ ፈቃዳቸውን ያደርግላቸዋል።
ታላቁንና ታናሹንም እንዲታዘዙላቸው ያደርጋል፤ በተራሮችና በኮረብቶች፥ በዋሻዎችና በጫካዎች፥ በምድር ጕድጓድም፥ በባሕርና በየብስም ውስጥ ያለው ሁሉ የእነርሱ ነው።
የአምላካቸውንም ፈቃድ ለሚያደርጉ፥ ሁሉ የእነርሱ ነው፤ ከበረከቱም አያሳጣቸውም፤ የምስጋናቸውንም ዋጋ ይሰጣቸዋል።
በሰማይም ለአባቶቻቸው ለአብርሃምና ለይስሐቅ፥ ለያዕቆብም፥ ከሕጉና ከትእዛዙ ላልወጡ ለዳዊትና ለሕዝቅያስ፥ ለሳሙኤልም ያዘጋጀውን ክብር ይሰጣቸዋል፤
From ancient times, may He grant them the inheritance promised to their fathers, to Abraham and to Isaac and to Jacob, and may He bring them joy in His kingdom.
Consider the names of those who perform good deeds; do not let their work be forgotten.
Rejoice that the kings and princes have endeavored to fulfill the will of the Lord; may your name be as their names, and may it be a dwelling place of light.
And as they are judged, know the names of the wicked kings and princes, who will be cast away after death; take heed.
While they see and hear, they do not turn their paths to the Lord, and those who have done the will of the Lord will be judged alongside the wicked and the sinners.
You also be kind and pure, but do not walk in the way of the wicked when the Lord is angry with them.
Indeed, judge in truth; vindicate your widow and the son of the dead; take your hand from those who are wicked.

From the hand of the wicked, stand firm as a father to the son of the dead; let not the strong be consumed in the fire of judgment, nor let the tears of the dead flow before you in the time of reckoning.
