Direct your feet to the path of peace; the eyes of the Lord are upon the righteous, and His ears are attentive to their prayers, seeking peace; follow them.
But the face of the Lord will erase their remembrance from the earth, for it is to the wicked that they do evil works; neither will He spare the man who dwells in the mountains and in the cliffs.
I will not turn my face away until they are destroyed; I will not answer those who call upon me, nor will I regard those who do not heed my words; I am the Lord, and I am a consuming fire.
I will honor those who honor Me, and those who keep My words shall be esteemed.
And let not your brother, whom you love, be led astray by the path of wickedness, for he is your brother, and you shall not harm him through your words.
For he has slain his brother in the day of his transgression; those who commit iniquity and deceit, and those who act wickedly against their neighbors, are like him.

Go forth upon the path of righteousness; there is no way that leads to destruction; for Abel is as a sheep that is led, and his blood is as the pure heart of man before God, even as the blood of a righteous lamb. Yet those who walk upon the path of righteousness shall love the Lord.
As Abel has become a witness, so shall the Lord love all who walk in righteousness, as the righteous and as the witness of Abel.

But the wicked, the Lord shall condemn; their judgment shall rest upon them, and their iniquity is written upon their foreheads. In the day of judgment, they shall be exposed before the angels and before men, and before all creation.
In that time, those who have not done the will of the Lord shall tremble before the prophets and the righteous.
"Until the end of the world, let them be cast into the fire of hell," such a dreadful word shall be given unto them.
ጌዴዎን እግዚአብሔርን በታመነው ጊዜ በጥቂት ሠራዊት እልፍና የብዙ ብዙ የሆኑ፥ እንደ አንበጣም ቍጥር የሌላቸው ያልተገረዙ የአሕዛብን ሠራዊት ድል ነሣ።
ነገሥታትና መኳንንት ሆይ! ያለ እኔ ሌላ አምላክ የለምና ሌሎች አማልክትን አትመኑ።
ከእናታችሁ ማኅፀን ያወጣኋችሁ፥ ያሳደግኋችሁም፥ የመገብኋችሁም፥ ያለበስኋችሁም እኔ አምላካችሁ እግዚአብሔር ነኝና ለምን ታመካኛላችሁ? ያለ እኔስ ሌላ አምላክን ለምን ታመልካላችሁ።
ይኸን ሁሉ አደረግሁላችሁ፤ ምንስ ሰጣችሁኝ? እኔስ ከእናንተ ምን እሻለሁ? የነፍሳችሁን መዳን ነው እንጂ፥ በሕጌና በሥርዐቴ፥ በትእዛዜም ትሔዱ ዘንድ፥ እኔም የነፍሳችሁን ድኅነት እሰጣችሁ ዘንድ ነው እንጂ፤
ሁሉን የሚገዛ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ አለ፥ “ከጣዖትና ከጥንቆላ፥ ከሟርትም ራሳችሁን አድኑ።”
በእነዚህ ይህን በሚያደርጉና በሚሰሟቸውም ላይ፥ ፈቃዳቸውን በሚያደርጉና ወዳጅም በሚሆኗቸው ላይ፥ በትእዛዛቸውም በሚሔዱ ላይ የእግዚአብሔር መቅሠፍት ይመጣባቸዋል።
የማያውቋችሁና የማይራሩላችሁ ሕዝብ ይነሡባችኋልና፥ የፈጠራችሁ የእግዚአብሔርንም ፈቃድ ካላደረጋችሁ ከነቢዩ ከሳሙኤል ጀምሮ ነቢያት እንደ ተናገሩ፥ ዳግመኛም ሕዝቅኤልና ሄኖክ እንደ ተናገሩ፥ አሳፍም እንደ ተናገረ የድካማችሁን ፍሬ ይበላሉ።
እንዲህም አለ፥ “ክፉ ሰዎች ልብሳቸውን ለውጠው ይመጣሉ፤ ከመብላትና ከመጠጣት፥ በብርና በወርቅም ከማጌጥ፥ እግዚአብሔርም የማይወድደውን ሥራ ሁሉ ከመሥራት በቀር ሌላ ሕግ የላቸውም።
እነርሱ ግን ወደ መብልና መጠጥ ለመሄድ የተዘጋጁ ናቸው፤ ከዕንቅልፋቸውም ከነቁ በኋላ ከጧት ጀምሮ እስከ ማታ ወደ ክፉ ሥራ ይሮጣሉ። በመንገዳቸው ጕስቍልናና ጥፋት እንጂ ለእግራቸው የሰላም ጎዳና የለውም።

የሰላም መንገድንም አያውቋትም፤ በዐይኖቻቸውም ፊት እግዚአብሔርን መፍራት የለም፤ ሃይማኖትና ምግባር የሌላቸው ጠማሞችና ክፉዎች ናቸው፤ ስስታሞች፥ በላተኞችና ጠጪዎች፥ ሰካራሞችና በደላቸውም ያለ ሕግ ነው። ወደ መዳራትና ደም ወደ ማፍሰስ ወደ ስርቆትና ወደ መክዳትም፥ በግፍም የሌላውን ገንዘብ ወደ መቀማት የሚሄዱ ናቸው።
ያለ ፍርድና ያለ ሕግም የሚወቅሱ ናቸው፤ የፈጠራቸው እግዚአብሔርንም አይፈሩትምና በፊታቸው ሐፍረት የለም።
የሚያዩትን የሰውን ፊት አያፍሩም፤ የሽበታምና የሽማግሌ ፊትን አያፍሩም፤ የዓለምንም ገንዘብ በሰሙ ጊዜ በዐይናቸው ሳያዩት የራሳቸው ገንዘብ ያደርጉታል፤ በዐይናቸው ፊት እግዚአብሔርን መፍራት የለምና በዐይናቸው በአዩት ጊዜ ባፋቸው የበሉት ይመስላቸዋል።
መኳንንቶቻቸውም ያደራ ገንዘብ ይበላሉ፤ እነርሱም ከዳተኞች ናቸውና፥ በአንደበታቸውም እውነት የለምና ጧት የተናገሩትን ማታ አይደግሙትም።
የድሆችንና የጦም አዳሪዎችን ጩኸት ቸል ይላሉና፥ ስደተኞችንም ከሚቀሟቸው እጅ አያድኗቸውምና የሚያውኩ ንጉሦቻቸው ለክፋት ይፋጠናሉ።
ስለዚህም የተበደለውንና ስደተኛውን ያድኗቸው እንጂ ነገሥታቱ ፍርድን የሚነፍጉ አይሁኑ።”
እነርሱ ግን ግብር የሚያስገብሩ ደምንም የሚጠጡ ወንጀለኞች ናቸው፤ መንገዳቸውም ክፉ ነውና እንቦሳዪቱን ከእናትዋ ጋር፥ ወፍንም ከጫጩቶችዋ ጋር ሲበሉ አይራሩም፤ ያዩትንና የሰሙትንም ሁሉ ለየራሳቸው ያደርጋሉ።
እነርሱ ለራሳቸው ይሰበስቡ ዘንድ ይወድዳሉ እንጂ ለሕመምተኞችና ለድሆች አይራሩም፤ በዐመፅም የሌላውን ገንዘብ ይቀማሉ፤ በቤታቸው ያደልቡ ዘንድ፥ በእርሱም ደስ ይላቸው ዘንድ ያገኙትን ሁሉ ይሰበስባሉ።
ከጕድጓዱ እንደ ወጣ፥ ፍለጋውም እንደማይገኝ፥ ወደ ቤቱም እንደማይመለስ አሸን ፈጥነው ይጠፋሉና፥ በሕይወታቸው ሳሉ በጎ ሥራን ስላልሠሩ እግዚአብሔር በቍጣው በያዛቸው ጊዜ ለነፍሳቸው ወዮላት።
እግዚአብሔር ቸል ባላቸው ጊዜ በአንድ ወገን እንደ አሉ አንድ ጊዜ ይጠፋሉ፤ እግዚአብሔርም ወደ ንስሓ ይመለሱ እንደ ሆነ ይታገሣቸዋል እንጂ ለማጥፋት አይቸኩልምና በጊዜው ይጠፋሉ።
ወደ ንስሓ ባይመለሱ ግን ከእነርሱ አስቀድሞ እንደ ነበሩ፥ የእግዚአብሔርን ትእዛዝ በሚገባ እንዳልጠበቁ ከእነርሱ በፊት እንደ ነበሩት ቀደምት ያጠፋቸዋል።

The flesh of man is for consumption, and the blood of man is for drinking; for they are ensnared in violence to lead to sin, and before them, there is no fear of God; after they rise from their slumber, they do not refrain from committing iniquity.
On the earth, many people perish in life, for their deeds are to eat and to drink, and they are led towards destruction and ruin.
Their way is darkened, for all who walk therein are led by the path of Satan; and the Lord God says, "Woe unto them, for in My wrath I shall seize them, and their bodies shall be a curse."
Yet they know not the way of the Lord; they have turned back from Him, and they have cast aside My law.

I too shall recompense them according to their deeds in the time of My judgment. On the day of reckoning, their deeds shall be as written before Me; for whether they are to be led, or to be made to stand, or to be cast down, I am the Lord God, and from My hand shall they not escape.

I am the Lord God, from the beginning to the end, for all creation is in My hand; beneath the earth and above the heavens, there is none that can escape from My grasp, whether in the sea or in the waters.
I have made the serpent beneath the earth, the fish within the sea, the birds that fly in the air, and the wild beasts of the wilderness; from the beginning to the end, all are Mine.

I am He who performs wondrous works and miracles; there is none that can escape from My hand, whether above in the heavens or below on the earth. Where dost thou go? What dost thou do? There is none that can answer Me.
I have dominion over the hosts of angels and the armies; the name that is called is all Mine; all the birds of heaven, and all the beasts of the field, and every creature are Mine.
The wind of the desert shall arise, and the sea of Eritrea shall be stirred up; it shall rise against her from the sound of the storm that comes forth.
He shall gather the living and the dead from Nob and from Saba, from Ethiopia and from Hindekush, along with all their regions and their borders.
In His hand, He holds the sword, and He shall keep all things in their season; for He shall surpass all the beasts of the field, and He shall keep the righteous in His sword.
ቀንዱም ከቀንዶች ሁሉ ይበልጣል። መንግሥቱም ከመንግሥት ሁሉ ከፍ ይላል። ሥልጣኑም ዓለሙን ሁሉ የሚገዛ ነው፤ ሁሉንም የሚችል ነው፤ የሚሳነውም የለም።
በላይ ደመናዎችን ያዝዛል፤ በታች ለእንስሳት ሣርን ያበቅላል፥ በዝርዝሩም ላይ ፍሬን ይሰጣል።
እንደ ወደደ ለሁሉ በየወገኑ ይመግባል፤ በየፍሬውም፥ በየምግቡም የፈጠረውን ሁሉ ይመግባል፤ በምድር በታችም ለገብረ ጕንዳን፥ ለኵብኩባ፥ ከምድር በላይም ለአውሬዎችና ለእንስሳት ይመግባቸዋል፤ ለሚጸልይም ጸሎቱን ይሰጠዋል፤ የባልቴቶችንና የሙት ልጆችን ልመና ቸል አይልም።
ይልቁንም በየጊዜው ወደ እርሱ የሚለምኑ የንጹሓንን ጸሎት ይቀበላል። የክፉ ሰዎች ወንጀላቸው እንደ ጥቅል ነፋስ፥ የበደለኞችም ጉባኤያቸው እንደ ጉም ሽንት ነውና።
ደስታቸውም እንደምትበር ወፍ ነውና፥ የብርና የወርቅ የሚሆን የመልካቸውም ደም ግባት በምድር ጠፊ ነውና ለዝንጉዎች መመርመሪያቸው ነው እንጂ ወርቃቸው አይጠቅማቸውም፤ ልብሳቸውንም ብል ይበላዋል።
የእህሉና የስንዴው ድልብም በትልና በነቀዝ ይበላል፤ ሁሉም ትናንትና እንዳለፈችው ቀን ያልፋል፤ ከአፍ የወጣ ቃልም እንደማይመለስ የኃጥአን ብዕላቸው እንደዚሁ ነው፤ የአማረ አኗኗራቸውም እንደሚያልፍ ጥላ ነው፤ የኃጥኣንም ብዕላቸው በእግዚአብሔር ፊት እንደ ተውሶ ልብስ ነው።
ጻድቃን ግን ቢበለጽጉ እግዚአብሔር ቸል አይላቸውም፤ ለድሃ እየራሩ፥ የሙት ልጆችንና የችግረኞችን ፍርድ እያዳመጡ፥ ከልብሳቸውም ለተራቆቱት እያለበሱ፥ እግዚአብሔር ከሰጣቸው ከቤታቸው ጥሪት ቸል ሳይሉ ለስደተኛውና ለጦም አዳሪው ይሰጡ ዘንድ በልጽገዋልና።
የመሃይምናንንም ፍርድ አያደሉም፤ የምንደኛውንም ደመወዝ አያሳድሩም፤ የእግዚአብሔር ነገር አፉ ሁለት እንደ ሆነ ሰይፍ እውነትና ክቡር ነውና በወራቶቻቸው ቍጥር፥ በሚዛናቸውም ልክ ዐመፅን አያደርጉም።
The poor, however, think deeply in their sleep; if they are not accepted by the rich, they become like dry wood; without wisdom, they cannot be hidden; without a root, they cannot be concealed.
The root serves to support the fruit, and if the root does not flourish, the fruit shall not be borne; for the essence of man is the fruit of righteousness, and without fruit, there is no good work.
If one works righteousness, he shall reap integrity; and the Lord delights in the truth and integrity of the one who works.
To the one who prays, He shall grant his prayers and the value of his supplication; and the righteous shall not be forsaken for the righteousness he has done.

The Lord is righteous; He loves righteousness, and for the evil that the wicked have done, He shall not spare them; for the soul of every man is held in His hand, and He is the one who possesses heaven and earth, and in judgment, He shall not show partiality to the rich or the poor.

The Lord created the entire world from nothing; He prepared the mountains and the hills, and He gathered the earth upon the waters; lest it be moved, He established it with a firm foundation; and in the beginning, the word of God was, "Let there be light."

When the world was in darkness, there was light; and the Lord performed His work; He prepared and established the world in order; let there be evening and darkness; and there was evening and darkness.
And again, the Lord said, "Let there be light," and it was light; He raised the waters above the firmament to the heavens.
As a vault, He spread it out; and by His breath, He established it; and the waters below were gathered in the depths of the sea.

He closed the depths of the sea with a boundary; and that they should not overflow, He established them by His Spirit; He brought forth the creatures and the beasts within it; the great creatures also, and every living thing that moves, both those that are seen and those that are unseen, He brought forth within it.
On the third day, the Lord caused the earth to bring forth vegetation, all kinds of herbs, trees, and the fruits that yield seed according to their kind.

To be seen, He made them beautiful; to be eaten, He created them delicious; the tree of life, and the herbs, and every plant that yields seed within itself, He created them all. For the cattle and for the beasts, and for the birds, He provided food; and for all that He created, He provided sustenance.

And it was evening; and it was morning; on the fourth day, the Lord said, "Let there be light in the firmament of the heavens," and the Lord created the sun, the moon, and the stars. To give light upon the earth, to govern the day and the night, and to separate the light from the darkness, He set them in the firmament of the heavens.
After this, the sun, the moon, and the stars, the day and the night were established.

On the fifth day, the Lord created every living creature that moves in the waters, and every bird that flies in the heavens; every creature that is seen and every creature that is unseen, all of these the Lord created.
በስድስተኛዪቱም ቀን አውሬዎችንና እንስሳትን፥ ትሎችንም ፈጠረ፤ ሁሉንም ፈጥሮና አዘጋጅቶ አዳምን በአርአያውና በምሳሌው ፈጠረው።
የፈጠራቸውን እንስሳትና አውሬዎችን ሁሉ ይነግሥባቸው ዘንድ ሰጠው፤ ዳግመኛም እንስሳትንና አራዊትን ሁሉ፥ ዓሣዎችንም ሁሉ፥ በባሕር ያሉ ዓሣ አንበሪዎችንም ሁሉ ሰጠው።
በምድር ላይ ያሉ ላሞችን ሁሉና በጎችንም፥ የሚታየውንና የማይታየውን እንስሳ ሁሉ ሰጠው።
በመልኩና በምሳሌው የፈጠረው አዳምንም በገነት አኖረው፤ ይበላ ዘንድ፥ ገነትንም ይኰተኵታት ዘንድ፥ በዚያ እግዚአብሔርን ያመሰግነው ዘንድ አዘዘው።
የእግዚአብሔርንም ትእዛዝ እንዳያፈርስ ሞትን ከሚያመጣ፥ ክፉና በጎንም ከሚያሳውቅ ዛፍ እንዳይበላ አዘዘው።
“ከዚያ ዛፍ በበላችሁ ጊዜ ሞትን ትሞታላችሁ” ብሏልና።
እናታችን ሔዋን በእባብ ማሳት ተሸንግላ ከዚያ ከዕፀ በለስ በላች፤ ለአባታችን ለአዳምም ሰጠችው።
ከዚያም ዛፍ በላ፤ በራሱና በልጆቹም ላይ ሞትን አመጣ።

ትእዛዙን አፍርሷልና፥ እግዚአብሔር ከእርሱ አትብላ ብሎ ካዘዘው ከዚያም ከዕፀ በለስ በልትዋልና እግዚአብሔር በአባታችን በአዳም ላይ ተቈጣ፤ ከገነትም አስወጥቶ ሰደደው፤ ያርሳት ዘንድ፥ በፊቱም ወዝ የድካሙን ዋጋ ይበላ ዘንድ ትእዛዙን በአፈረሰ ጊዜ ስለ እርሱ የረገማትን፥ አሜከላና እሾህን የምታበቅል ያችን ምድር ሰጠው።
እግዚአብሔርም ወደዚች ምድር በአወጣው ጊዜ አዳም ወደ ኀዘንና ወደ ልብ ትካዜ ተመለሰ። ምድርንም ያርሳት ዘንድ፥ በፊቱ ወዝ፥ በልፋትና በድካምም ይበላ ጀመር።
And after this, their children were numerous; and among them were those who praised the Lord and gave Him thanks, and they did not forsake His commandments.

There were also prophets who spoke of that which was and that which was to come; and among their children were those who spoke lies, and wicked men who oppressed others; for Cain, the son of Adam, was evil, and he killed his brother Abel.
And because he killed his brother Abel, the Lord was exceedingly angry with Cain; and because he drank his blood, the Lord was angry with the earth.
And the Lord said to Cain, "Where is your brother Abel?" And Cain, in his heart full of pride, said, "Am I my brother's keeper?"
Abel was righteous; but Cain, being a wicked man, became a murderer of his brother Abel.
And a righteous woman was also born; Adam fathered thirty women and thirty men. Among them were both the righteous and the wicked.
Among them were prophets and the righteous; and among them were the wicked and the deceitful.

And from them, they kept the command of their father Adam, from Adam until the command of God was preserved until the righteous Noah; and they were those who fulfilled all that was spoken to their children, both male and female.
And he also kept the law of God for his children; and as their father Noah did not forsake the law of God, so they also taught their children, that they might keep the law of God and not forsake it.
And they also remained, teaching their children after them.

But Satan, in order to bury their fathers, brought forth their idols, and when the people who said "Amen" were gathering and speaking to them, they remained; and that teacher of iniquity commanded all that they did.
The righteous Abraham, who fulfilled the will of the Lord, remained until he arose, as they were turning their idols according to their customs.
And the Lord made a covenant with him in fire and in a mighty word. He has gone before them in the path of righteousness, separate from the ages.
And the Lord shall give him and his sons the land of inheritance until the end of the world, which is to say.
Likewise, to Isaac, that he may give him the inheritance of his father Abraham; and to Jacob, likewise, that he may give him the inheritance of his father Isaac.
And after them, he made the children of Jacob, the twelve, into the kings and priests of Israel; and he blessed them, saying, "Be fruitful, and multiply greatly."
He gave them the inheritance of their fathers; yet, while they were entering, they did not cease to provoke the Lord in all their ways.
In the time of their distress, they shall seek Him; they shall return and humble themselves before the Lord; for the Lord will love them and will forgive them.
It is not for their own sake; it is for the sake of their fathers, but for all that He has created, He does not withhold mercy.
To cover the body of the afflicted, His right hand shall be stretched out in blessing; for food, He shall multiply the grain, and for mercy, He shall open His eyes.
ለቍራዎች ጫጩቶችና ለሚጠሩት ሁሉ ምግብን ይሰጣቸዋል፤ ወደ እርሱም በጮሁ ጊዜ፥ የእስራኤልን ልጆች ከጠላቶቻቸው እጅ ያድናቸዋል።
ዳግመኛም ያሳዝኑት ዘንድ ይመለሳሉ፤ እርሱም በዙሪያቸው ያሉ ጠላቶቻቸውን አሕዛብን ልኮ ያጠፏቸዋል፥ ይገድሏቸዋል፥ ይማርኳቸዋልም።
ዳግመኛም በጩኸትና በልቅሶ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ይጮኻሉ፤ እርሱም ረዳትን ይልክላቸዋል፤ በነቢያት እጅም ያዳነበት ጊዜ አለ።
በመሳፍንትም እጅ ያዳነበት ጊዜ አለ፤ እግዚአብሔርንም ባሳዘኑት ጊዜ ጠላቶቻቸው አስገበሯቸው፤ ማረኳቸውም።
ዳዊትም ተነሥቶ ከኢሎፍላውያን እጅ አዳናቸው፤ ዳግመኛም እግዚአብሔርን አሳዘኑት፤ የሚያስጨንቋቸውንም አስነሣባቸው።
በዮፍታሔም እጅ ያዳነበት ጊዜ አለ፤ ዳግመኛም ያዳናቸውን እግዚአብሔርን ዘነጉት። እግዚአብሔር ፍዳውን አምጥቶባቸዋልና ክፉ የሆኑ፥ መከራን የሚያጸኑባቸውን፥ ፈጽመውም የሚማርኳቸውን ጠላቶችን ይልክባቸዋል።
ዳግመኛም በተጨነቁ ጊዜ ወደ እርሱ ጮሁ፤ እርሱም በጌዴዎን እጅ አዳናቸው፤ ዳግመኛም በእጃቸው ሥራ እግዚአብሔርን አሳዘኑት።
እርሱም ዳግመኛ የሚያሰቃዩአቸውን ላከባቸው፤ ተመልሰውም ወደ እግዚአብሔር አለቀሱ፤ ጮኹም።
ዳግመኛም በሶምሶን እጅ አዳናቸው፤ ጥቂትም ዐረፉ። አስቀድመውም በሠሩት ክፋታቸው እግዚአብሔርን ያሳዝኑት ዘንድ ተነሡ።
እርሱም ዳግመኛ የሚያስጨንቋቸውን ሌሎችን ላከባቸው። ዳግመኛም ረዳትን ይልክላቸው ዘንድ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ጮሁ፤ አለቀሱም፤ በባርቅና በዲቦራም እጅ አዳናቸው።
ዳግመኛም እግዝአብሔርን እያመለኩት ጥቂት ዘመን ኖሩ፤ ዳግመኛም ረሱት፤ በቀደመ ክፋታቸውም እግዚአብሔርን አሳዝኑት።
እርሱም የሚያስጨንቋቸውን ሌሎችን ላከባቸው፤ ዳግመኛም በዮዲት እጅ አዳናቸው፤ ዳግመኛም ጥቂት ወራት ተቀምጠው እንደ ቀደመው እግዚአብሔርን በክፋታቸው ያሳዝኑት ዘንድ ተነሡ።
እርሱም የሚገዟቸው አሕዛብን አስነሣባቸው፤ እነርሱም ወደ እግዚአብሔር ጮሁ፤ አለቀሱም፤ በማታትዩና በልጆቹ እጅ በቤት ማዕዘን ላይ አዳናቸው።
የይሁዳን ሀገር ይወጋ ዘንድ የመጣው አሂሜሌክ የረዓይታዊውን ራስ መትቶታልና፤ ያም ራዓይታዊ በሞተ ጊዜ ሠራዊቱ ተበተኑ፤ ሸሹም፤ የእስራኤልም ልጆች እስከ ኢያቦቅ ወጉአቸው፤ ከእነርሱም አንድ እንኳ የሚሸሽ አላስቀሩም።
ከዚህ በኋላ ጥቂት ቈይተው እግዚአብሔርን ያሳዝኑት ዘንድ ተነሡ፤ እርሱም የሚገዟቸው አሕዛብን አስነሣባቸው፤ ዳግመኛም ወደ እግዚአብሔር ጮሁ፤ አለቀሱም፤ እግዚአብሔርም ሁልጊዜ አሳዝነውታልና፥ ሕጉንም ረስተዋልና እግዚአብሔር ጩኸታቸውንና ልቅሷቸውን ቸል አለ።
ማርከውም ከካህናቶቻቸው ጋር ወደ ከለዳውያን ሀገር ወሰዷቸው።
በዚያም ኀጢአትን እየሠሩ፥ ጣዖትንም እያመለኩ ከዳተኞች የእስራኤል ልጆች እግዚአብሔርን ማሳዘንን አልተዉም። ከማረኩዋቸው ከአሕዛብም ጋር ተቀላቀሉ።
እግዚአብሔርም በዚያ በኀጢአታቸው አንድ ጊዜ ያጠፋቸው ዘንድ ተቈጣ፤ በንጉሡም ሣጥን እልፍ ወርቅን አግብቶ በታወቀች ቀን ያጠፋቸው ዘንድ በነገረው ጊዜ ከሕንደኬ ጀምሮ እስከ ኢትዮጵያ ድረስ በፋርስ ሀገር ልጆቻቸውን እንዳያስቀር በንጉሡ በአርጤክስስ ልቡና ቍጣን አሳደረ።
እንዲህም አደረገ፥ በንጉሡ ፈቃድ የመልእክት ደብዳቤ ጻፈ፤ ወደ ፋርስም ሀገር ያደርስ ዘንድ በእጁ ያለ ማኅተምን ሰጠው።
ንጉሥ እንዳዘዘ ሊያጠፋቸው በወደደባት ባንዲት ቀን ያጠፋቸው ዘንድ ማኅተምን ሰጠው፤ ብዝበዛቸውን ወርቁንና ብሩን ግን ወደ ንጉሡ ሣጥን ያገቡ ዘንድ አዘዘ።
And at that time, the children of Israel, when they heard this, cried out to the Lord; and they lamented; and they spoke concerning Mordecai; and Mordecai spoke to Esther.
And Esther said, "Fast; pray; let all the children of Israel and their kin, wherever you are, cry out to the Lord."
And Mordecai went out to the city; and he cried out in his own place; and the children of Israel fasted, prayed, and sought mercy.
And Esther was greatly distressed; though she was queen, she was troubled; and she was in anguish; and she cried out to her Creator, the God of her fathers, with a deep heart; and she lamented.
Therefore, before the king of Persia, she offered him a great feast for the sake of her fathers' Creator.

The king and Haman entered to the banquet she had prepared; and there, concerning Mordecai, he did as he was pleased, for he had desired to present a gift to the Lord; and they were hanged upon a long tree.
By his decree, all that they had, Israel was to be destroyed, lest they be consumed, lest they be exterminated, lest they be impoverished, and their wealth be taken from them.

That they should not destroy their land, nor plunder their possessions; but rather, throughout the land of Persia, they should be loved and honored; thus the decree was issued. In their distress and when they cried out, the Lord said to Israel, "Thus shall I have mercy upon you."

In the time of their affliction, He will raise up nations that will trouble them; and at that time, He will send them help from their distress, from the hand of the nations that oppress them; they shall cry out.
የግብፅም ሰዎች የእስራኤልን ልጆች በጭንቅ፥ ጡብ በማሠራት፥ በሚያሠሩአቸውም ሥራ ሁሉ፥ ያለ ገለባ ጭቃ በማስረገጥ በአስጨነቋቸው ጊዜ፥
ሠሪዎችን የሚያፋጥኑ አለቆችንም በእነርሱ ላይ ሾመው ባሠሯቸው ጊዜ የግብፅን ጡብ ሁሉ ከመሥራት ያድናቸው ዘንድ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ጮሁ።
የዚያን ጊዜም የሚረዷቸውን ሙሴንና አሮንን ላከላቸው፤ ከግብፅ ንጉሥ ከፈርዖን አገዛዝ ቤት ወገኖቹን ያወጡ ዘንድ እግዚአብሔር ልኳቸዋልና ከጡብ ሥራ አዳኗቸው፤ ለእግዚአብሔር እንዳይገዙ፥ በምድረ በዳም መሥዋዕት እንዳይሠዉ በትዕቢቱ እስራኤልን ማሰናበት እንቢ ብሏልና።
እግዚአብሔርም ትዕቢተኞችን ቸል ይላቸዋልና ፈርዖንን ስለ ትዕቢቱ ከሠራዊቱ ጋር በኤርትራ ባሕር አሰጠመው።
እንዲሁም ነገሥታትና መኳንንት ሲሆኑ የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል ቸል የሚሉ፥ ፈቃዱንም ይፈጽሙለት ዘንድ፥ በበጎም ነገር ለሚያገለግሉ ሰዎች ደመወዛቸውን ይሰጧቸው ዘንድ፥ ገናና ስሙንም ያከብሩ ዘንድ በሾማቸውና በአነገሣቸው ሁሉ መልካም ያልሠሩትን ቸል ይላቸዋል።
“መንግሥቴን ቢያቀኑ መንግሥታቸውን አቀናላቸዋለሁ ይላል ሁሉን የሚችል እግዚአብሔር።
መልካም አድርጉልኝ፤ እኔም መልካም አደርግላችኋለሁ፤ ትእዛዜን ጠብቁ፤ እኔም ሰውነታችሁን እጠብቃለሁ፤ በትእዛዜ ሒዱ፤ እኔም እንደ ልቡናችሁ እሔዳለሁ።
እኔን ውደዱ፤ እኔም ሕይወታችሁን እወድዳለሁ፤ ወደ እኔ ተጠጉ፥ እኔም አጸናችኋለሁ።
በእኔ እመኑ፤ እኔም አድናችኋለሁ ይላል ሁሉን የሚችል እግዚአብሔር።
እናንተ አግድም አግድም አትሒዱ፤ እናንተ ቅረቡኝ፤ እኔም እቀርባችኋለሁ፤ ቀና መንገዶችን እወድዳለሁና ይላል ሁሉን የሚችል እግዚአብሔር። ኃጥኣንና ከዳተኞች፥ እጆቻችሁን አንጹ፤ የልቡናችሁንም ክፋት አስወግዱ፤
እኔም ቍጣዬን ከእናንተ አርቃለሁ፤ በይቅርታና በምሕረትም እመለስላችኋለሁ።
በደልን የሚሠሩ ወንጀለኞች ጠላቶችንም ከእናንተ አርቃለሁ፤ ባሪያዬ ዳዊትን ከተገናኙት ከጠላቶቹ ከብዙ ተንኰላቸው፥ አርበኛ ከሆነ ከጎልያድም እጅ፥ ይገድለውም ዘንድ ከፈለገው ከሳኦል እጅ፥ መንግሥቱን ይወስድ ዘንድ ከወደደ ከልጁ ከአቤሴሎምም እጅ እንዳዳንሁት፥
ሕጌን የሚጠብቁ፥ ፈቃዴንም የሚፈጽሙ ሰዎችንም እንደ እርሱ አድናቸዋለሁ፤ ክብርንም አወርሳቸዋለሁ፤ በዚህም ዓለም በሚመጣውም ዓለም ደስ ይላቸው ዘንድ በሁሉ ላይ አነግሣቸዋለሁ።”
እርሱ ሕጻን ሆኖ ሳለ ከሕጻንነቱ ጀምሮ በአማረ አኗኗሩ እግዚአብሔር እንደ መረጠው እንደ ሳሙኤል በአማረ አኗኗራቸው እግዚአብሔርን ካገለገሉ ቡሩካን ነገሥታት ጋር አንድ ይሆናሉ።
ሥራው መልካም ለሆነ ለአረጋዊው ካህን ለኤሊ ይነግረው ዘንድ በእግዚአብሔር አምላክ ማደሪያ ሲያገለግል ለነቢዩ ሳሙኤል ነገረው።
በእግዚአብሔርም ቤት እያገለገለ በአደገ ጊዜ በእግዚአብሔር ትእዛዝ ሕዝቡን እንዲሾምና ነገሥታቱን እንዲቀባ አደረገው። እግዚአብሔርም ከእስራኤል ልጆች የመረጠውን ወገን ይሾም ዘንድ ወድዶታልና የፈጠረው የእግዚአብሔርን ፈቃድ በፈጸመ ጊዜ በእጁ ቅብዐ መንግሥትን ሰጠው።
ሳኦልም በመንግሥቱ ሳለ እግዚአብሔር ነቢዩ ሳሙኤልን እንዲህ አለው፥ “ከይሁዳ ወገን የተወለደ የዕሤይ ልጅ ዳዊትን ወድጄዋለሁና ሒድና ቅባው።”
"I am grieved because my voice has been cast aside, and I have become an enemy to the house of Saul."
"And I am not troubled; I have not kept watch over my voice, nor have I spoken from my kin."
"Likewise, those who do not keep my voice, and who do not walk according to my law and my statutes, I shall cast away from their children until the end of the ages."
"In the time when they have not cared for me, and in the time when they have not honored me, I shall destroy them; yet I shall not return to honor them."
"In the time when I have done good to them, they do not do good to me; and in the time when I have shown mercy to them, they do not say, 'Forgive us.'"
"Above all, when I have done a great thing for them, they do not do a great thing for me; and more than all, when they have honored me, they do not honor me; they do not keep my command."

"I have lifted up the gift that I have given to them; in my anger, I do not respond to them as I should; the God who is able to do all things says this: 'I will honor those who honor me; and I will love those who love me.'"
"I shall remember those who have not honored me, and those who have not kept my law, I shall cast away from the gift I have given to them."
"The God who is able to do all things says this: 'I will love those who love me; and I will care for those who care for me.'"

"I am the Lord God, who is able to do all things; in heaven above and on the earth below, there is none that can deliver from my hand; whether to save or to destroy, whether to forgive or to condemn, I am the Lord God."
Glory and majesty are mine; I will honor those whom I love; I will bring down those who oppose me; for I am the judge and the avenger.
"I am he who is called by those who love me and who call upon my name; I am the one who provides food for the needy and the destitute."
It is not only man; rather, I also provide for the birds and the beasts, for the fish that are in the sea and the creatures that dwell therein, even for the serpents, I will provide.
For the locusts and the fish, for the grasshoppers and the ants, I will also provide sustenance.
All that moves in the waters, and all that flies in the air, is mine.
To all who seek me in their need and in their want, I am the one who provides sustenance.
"No king shall reign without My command; nor shall the mighty prevail without My decree; and the strong shall not be victorious without My order."
"I have granted wisdom to Solomon, and to David I have given understanding; and to Hezekiah I have added years."
"I have raised up the time of Goliath; and I have given strength to Samson; and I have delivered the mighty into his hand."
"I have delivered My servant David from the hand of the Philistine, from the hand of Goliath."
"And I have delivered the mighty from the hand of the king, from Saul; and likewise from the hand of the other Philistine, from all who contend and seek to harm him; for he has kept My command."
"And I love him; I cherish those kings and princes who keep My command; for they have brought joy to My heart, and I shall grant them strength and victory over their enemies."
"And the mighty shall inherit the land of their fathers, and I shall give them the inheritance of the land of freedom and of brightness, which I have prepared for their fathers."

"And you, O princes and rulers, hear My voice; keep My commandments, saith the Lord God, who is able to do all things. He who has preserved you and has protected you, from your fathers onward, He shall bless you in all that you seek."

"And to the earth, He shall bring you forth, as it is fitting, and the blessing of the earth shall be upon you; the fruit of the vine and the oil, which have not been withheld from you, and the water of the well that has not been denied you."

"The honey of the bee, and the milk of the goat, with the bread of wheat, He shall provide for them all that they need; for their God is the Lord, and as I have instructed you, do not let your hearts be troubled, as the children of Israel."
"He has not withheld from me that which was not given."
"And David the Psalmist said: 'People have eaten the bread of angels, as it was said, and they have wandered in the wilderness; I have done all that is fitting and true to them.'"
"Yet they did not regard me; and I too shall say, 'Let all who can do so, say to the Lord God, 'They have strayed from my path.'"

"I too shall repay them according to their deeds. For they have called my prayer a burden, and in my counsel and in my law they have not heeded, and according to their works I shall bring them to judgment, and I shall cast them into hell."
"They have not kept my commandments; therefore, I shall bring them to judgment in the days of their earthly existence."
"O King! You, who are subject to death and who trembles, are you not a man who is not great in your own sight?"
"But today, you are like a man who shall not die forever; you shall perish."
"You are today in good health, but they say you are a man who shall die; for the Lord God, who can do all things, speaks."

"If you keep my commandments and my words, and if their dwelling is bright, and their spouses are of noble birth, and their thrones are of silver and gold, then those who dwell upon them shall be exalted, and I shall bring forth a holy city together with the kings whom I have honored."
"In the city where good works are done, there shall be a dwelling place provided for those who labor, and they shall rejoice within it."
"But for those who do evil, they shall not enter that city where the great kings dwell."
"I do not keep my commandments and my statutes, and they say, 'The Lord God, who is able to do all things.'"
የሜዶን መንግሥት ትጠፋለች፤ የሮም መንግሥት ግን በመቄዶንያ መንግሥት ላይ ፈጽማ ትጸናለች፤ የነነዌም መንግሥት በፋርስ መንግሥት ላይ ትጸናለች።
የኢትዮጵያ መንግሥትም በእስክንድርያ መንግሥት ላይ ትጸናለች፤ የሞዓብም መንግሥት በአማሌቅ ላይ ትጸናለች።
ወንድም በወንድሙ ላይ ይነሣል፤ ይተላለቁም ዘንድ እንደ ተናገረ እግዚአብሔር በቀልን ያደርጋል።
እንዲህም አለ፥ “መንግሥት በመንግሥት ላይ፥ ሕዝብም በሕዝብ ላይ፥ ሀገርም በሀገር ላይ ይነሣል።
ክርክርም ይሆናል፤ ሰልፍ፥ ረኀብ ፥ ቸነፈር፥ ንውጥውጥታ፥ ድርቅም ይሆናል፤ ሰላምና ፍቅርም ይጠፋልና የእግዚአብሔር መቅሠፍት በእርሷ ላይ ይወርዳል።
ከምሥራቅ እስከ ምዕራብ እንደሚታይ መብረቅም የምታስፈራ የእግዚአብሔር ቀን በድንገት በደረሰች ጊዜ፥
የዚያን ጊዜ ሰው ሁሉ እንደ ሥራውና እንደ እጁ ድካም፥ እንደ ሥራውም ፍሬ ይቀበላል፤ እርሱ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ብሏልና፥ በፍርድ ቀንና እግራቸው በሚሰነካከልበት ቀን እበቀላቸዋለሁ፥ ለጥፋት የሚቈጠሩበት ቀን ደርሷልና።
“የዚያን ጊዜ እግዚአብሔር በሕጉ የማይሄዱ ክፉ አድራጊዎችን በዘለዓለም ኵነኔ ያጠፋቸዋል፤ የይሁዳና የቆጵሮስ፥ የሰማርያና የደማስቆ፥ የባቢሎንም ሕዝብ፥
በምዕራብ ደሴትም የሚኖሩ ሕንደኬና ኖባ፥ ሳባና ግብፅም፥ ኢትዮጵያም በእነርሱም የሚኖሩ ሁሉ።
ያንጊዜም ሰማይንና ምድርን የምገዛ፥ ክብርንና መወደድን የምሰጥ፥ የምገድልና የማድንም እኔ እግዚአብሔር እንደ ሆንሁ ያውቃሉ።
I am the one who brings forth the sun; and I am the one who looks towards the entrance; I am the one who brings forth both the evil and the good.
I am the one who brings forth the money that you have earned, and the provisions of your flocks and herds, which you do not know how to manage.

"Your children shall be brought before you, as they are being led astray; and you shall not be able to save them. For the Spirit of the Lord has not been poured out upon you, and you do not fear the command of the Lord that you have heard, and thus they shall consume you and your desires."
For I do not possess the Spirit of the Lord upon you, as it was said to the prophet Daniel; for the Spirit of the Lord that was upon him knows all things.

And the Spirit of the Lord that was upon him knows all things; and the one who is revealed shall be made known; for he knows all that is revealed and all that is hidden, but there is none who is hidden from the Spirit of the Lord.
But we are indeed those who are destined to die, and all the work that we have done shall be made known.
And just as gold and silver are tested by fire, so shall they not keep the command of the Lord, and thus they shall be tested on the day of reckoning.
In those days, all the children of Israel and all the nations shall be tested in their works.
"Because your father and mother have not judged the son who is destined for death, the Lord shall be angry with you, and woe unto you, O mighty ones of Israel."

"You who go to the house of the oppressor in the morning and in the evening, and you who execute judgment, and you who do not heed the judgment of the son destined for death and the judgment of your spouse, woe unto you, for you dwell in sin and in oppression."
"The Lord shall say unto the mighty ones of Israel, 'If you do not walk in My commandments, and if you do not keep My word, and if you do not love what I love, woe unto you!'"
"I shall bring upon you desolation and destruction; I shall bring upon you calamity; you shall perish like the chaff, and your search shall not be found in your regions."

"Your land shall become a wilderness; all who once beheld it shall shake their hands; has this land, which was filled with blessings and all good things, not become desolate? The Lord said, 'Is it not the sins of the people who dwell therein that have brought this upon it?'"

"The Lord shall bring down her pride until she is humbled; she shall be exalted high, and she shall be brought low; and because of the pride of those who dwell within her, she shall become a wilderness, and woe unto her!"
"She has become a desolation and a wilderness; the beasts of the field shall dwell within her."

"Within her, she has become a terror to those who pass by; for the wrath of the Lord is upon her, and because of her pride and the wickedness of those who dwell within her, she shall be consumed by the fire of judgment."
The men of Moab, do not be afraid; and the Amalekites, do not let your hearts be troubled; for the Lord your God is with you.
Though you lift yourselves high to the heavens, you shall surely descend to Sheol.
When Israel formerly entered the land of Egypt from the kingdom of Moab and Midian, they said, "Do not be afraid, for it is not right to provoke the Lord your God."
"O you son of a bondwoman, why do you trouble your own soul? When the earth shall judge you, do you not think that the Lord will judge you on the day of reckoning?"
In that day, as your hand works, so shall you receive; why do you lift your heart high? Why do you trouble your own soul? The Lord, who possesses all, shall say.
As you have troubled those who are not your kin, so shall I trouble you; for you shall do evil, and I shall place you in a place of shame.
Likewise, I shall do unto you, says the Lord who is able to do all things. If you do good, and if you love those whom I love, I shall hear you in all that you ask.
If you do my will, I shall do your will; I shall also deliver your enemies; I shall bless your work, your seed, and your children.
I shall bless your flocks and your herds; if you walk in my command, I shall bless all that you do, says the Lord who is able to do all things.

"If you do my will, and if you walk in my command and my law, then all that was spoken before shall come upon you; for you shall not be able to escape my wrath, nor shall you be able to flee from my law, and you shall not be able to withstand my anger when you come upon me."
I have not loved you as you have loved me; for I have created you to bring you to existence, and I have been called to give thanks and to praise you.

That you may do all that you love, I have given you honor and lordship beneath you. That you may be exalted and preserved, that you may work and be fruitful, that you may be honored and revered, that you may act high and low, this was yours.
If you do the will of the Lord, and walk in His commandment, you shall rejoice in His lordship, and you shall be a partaker with those who have inherited the holy land.

He has said thus: "If they honor me, I will bring them honor and love; in my house of worship, I will give them joy; as the offerings of the chosen and beloved, they shall be, says the Lord God, who is able to do all things."
To escape from death to life, do not neglect to do good and to follow the path of righteousness.
But those who do good works, the Lord will keep them safe from all evil, as He kept Job, that they may be as his sons, and the Lord will protect them in all their goodness.
In their time of distress, like unto Abraham, when they were beset by idols, their bodies were afflicted by day and by night; as Abraham was delivered from them by the hand of the Lord, as was Moses.
Yet he was not dismayed, as they turned to their idols; he was delivered from them.
He was not dismayed; he regarded the Creator, the Lord God. From his lineage began to believe in Him, for Abraham was a friend of God.

He was wholly devoted to the Lord, and until his death, he did not cease to praise the Lord; until the day of his death, he did not depart from His command; and he taught his children to keep the commandments of the Lord.

And they did not forsake the command of God, as their father Abraham had done; saying, “I have a friend named Abraham in the land,” as the Lord spoke concerning them, the sons of Abraham, Isaac and Jacob, who did not depart from the law of God.
“Abraham is my friend; Isaac is my beloved; Jacob is the one whom my heart loves; and concerning them, I have been blessed,” says the Lord, the God who is able to do all things.
When the children of Israel were utterly forsaken, they remained in sorrow; and when He delivered them, they dwelt in the wilderness, as they entered into the desert.
Their garments were not torn; for they had eaten the bread of knowledge, and their feet did not stumble.
But their hearts were always far from God; from ancient times, they were those who wrought iniquity, and they had no hope for salvation.

They were like a withered vine; yet in their wickedness, they did not seek the Lord, as their fathers had done, as Abraham and Isaac, and as Jacob; they were not; for their idols, upon the mountain and in the grove, continually caused them sorrow; upon the mountain, beneath the shade and the trees, they were consumed.
They were filled with fear; their sacrifices were offered; by their hands, they rejoiced; they would eat the offerings, and they would drink the libations; they would dance and play together.
Their games and their songs, all their merriment, were a burden to them; they would perform the lamentations that the Lord did not love, and they would offer their abominations and their sins.
For the idols of Canaan, for the feast and for the idols of Midian, for the idols of Elohim, for Dagon and for Apollo, for Artemis and for Serapis,

Around them, they offered sacrifices to all the idols of the nations. The nations did as they pleased, and they offered all that was required; the nations would perform their games and their songs, and they would do their dances.
We shall behold the Lord God, as the people of Israel have done. They were to keep the commandments of the Lord God and to forsake the idols.

When they entered the land of Judah, and when they went forth to the earth, they were to avoid the abominations surrounding them, and they were not to worship other gods, as Moses had commanded them in the Law.
They did not lift up their desires or their longings; for He is their God, and He would accept those whom they cherished.
Yet they did not cease to grieve the Lord; in the time of their joy, they would provoke the Lord to anger.
And when they were in distress, they would cry out to Him; when they were in trouble, He would deliver them; and again, in clarity, He would bring them joy; and they would dwell for many seasons.

And again, as before, they would harden their hearts against the Lord; they would return to their own ways, and they would provoke the surrounding nations against them; they would be troubled and beset.
And again, they would turn back and hasten to their Creator, and they would cry out to the Lord.

He would say to them, "Forgive them," for in their wickedness from ancient times, they had provoked the Lord because of their deeds and because of their fathers, because of Noah, because of Abraham, and because of Isaac, and because of Jacob; it was not for their own sake.
As the heavens are higher than the stars and as the sea is deeper than the abyss, so He would regard those whom they cherished and the commandments they kept.
As the sea is deeper, at the time of the resurrection of the dead, the souls of the wicked shall be separated from the children of Israel and shall enter into hell.

In the heavens, they are as the stars that shine; yet, among the children of Israel, they are the souls of the righteous. The Lord spoke unto Abraham, saying, “Look now toward heaven, and count the stars, if thou be able to number them; and so shall thy seed be, the righteous shall shine as the stars in the kingdom of heaven.”
“And again look unto the sea and unto the riverbank; behold what is therein, and count; for in the time of the resurrection of the dead, thy children shall descend into hell, even as these.”
And Abraham believed in the Lord; and he counted it to him for righteousness; and his hope reached unto the earth; and his wife Sarah bore him a son, Isaac, after she had ceased to bear.
And again, by his faith, he shall obtain a kingdom in the heavens. The dead shall rise; and those who have done good works shall enter into everlasting life.

But those who have done evil shall go to everlasting punishment in the time of the resurrection of the dead; I have faith in this. Yet the righteous who have done good works shall dwell with Him for eternity.
Those who have done evil shall be condemned to everlasting punishment; Amen, Amen.
